jobs.title: Workshop & Repairs Technician (f/m/d) 80-100%
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Service Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities
In this role, you will play a key role in the installation, maintenance, and repair of UPS systems and battery installations. You will diagnose and resolve technical issues efficiently, ensuring reliable and cost-effective solutions for our customers. Working in accordance with ABB policies, procedures, and safety standards, you will contribute to the continuous improvement of product quality and reliability. Leveraging your technical expertise and customer-focused approach, you will build strong relationships with customers and support the identification of new business opportunities. You will operate within ABB's established processes and quality standards, helping to deliver excellent service and customer satisfaction.


The work model for the role is: onsite

This role is contributing to the Electrification, Smart Power Business in Baden, Kanton Aargau.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Perform and coordinate repair and maintenance activities on UPS systems and battery installations, including fault diagnosis, testing, and inspections.

  • Manage and maintain loan equipment and UPS modules.

  • Ensure the proper maintenance and availability of tools, equipment, and testing facilities.

  • Assist with inventory and warehouse management, including the procurement of spare parts and consumable materials.

​

• Qualifications for the role

  • Successfully completed vocational training in Electrical Engineering (Electrician, Electrical Installer, Electronics Technician, or equivalent).

  • Proven experience working with UPS systems, battery installations, and power electronics.

  • Fluent German language skills; English and Italian proficiency is considered a plus.

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

  • Reliable, proactive, and customer-focused, with a strong sense of responsibility and the ability to work independently.

​

Benefits

We also offer our employees the following benefits:

  • Employee Share Acquisition Plan (ESAP)

  • REKA credits

  • Exclusive employee discounts (MyDiscounts / Swibeco)

  • Parental leave

  • Contribution towards fitness and health programs

  • Eco Bonus (sustainability incentive)

More about us
ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.


This recruitment process is being managed by Talent Partner Ece Özen.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.title: Senior Sales Engineer, French Fluency Required (80–100%)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Local Division Manager

__

Your Role and • Responsibilities

In this role, you will spend approximately 80% of your time at customer sites. You will acquire new business partners and continuously develop existing customer relationships. By leveraging your technical expertise and sales experience, you will understand customer needs and clearly articulate the value of our electric motors and variable frequency drives (low voltage and medium voltage).

As a key driver of growth in our drives business, you will succeed through knowledgeable consulting and clear value‑based selling—ranging from energy efficiency to CO₂ reduction. Your objective is to deliver solutions that are not only technically strong but also contribute to a more sustainable and environmentally responsible industry.

This role follows a hybrid work model. #LI‑Hybrid

Key • Responsibilities

  • Customer Acquisition & Account Management: Spend approximately 80% of your time on site with customers, identifying new business opportunities and expanding existing customer relationships.

  • Technical Consulting: Advise customers on electric motors and variable frequency drives (LV & MV) and present solutions tailored to their technical and business requirements.

  • Value Communication: Clearly communicate the benefits of our products, including improved energy efficiency and reduced CO₂ emissions.

  • Relationship Management: Build trust, identify key stakeholders, and strategically position our solutions.

  • Market & Industry Awareness: Monitor trends in the drives and motion industry and contribute innovative ideas.

Your • Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or technical training in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a comparable field.

  • Several years of experience in sales, with strong knowledge of electric motors and variable frequency drives (LV & MV).

  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills.

  • Willingness to travel extensively (approximately 80% field‑based).

  • Strong interest in energy efficiency and sustainable solutions.

  • Fluent in German and French.

What We Offer

  • An exciting sales role with significant autonomy and impact.

  • Access to innovative products and solutions within the Motion business area.

  • Ongoing learning opportunities and attractive career development prospects.

  • Modern work tools and flexible work arrangements.

More about us

ABB Motors and Drives offers a comprehensive portfolio of motors, generators, and drive products for a wide range of industries and applications. Our mission is to be a trusted expert in automated industrial systems, with a strong focus on reliability, long‑term partnerships, and a deep understanding of our customers’ needs.

The recruitment process is led by Ece Özen, Talent Partner, ABB Switzerland Ltd.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.title: Head of Portfolio Management
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Head of Technology & Innovation

__

Lead the future of industrial automation, digitalization, and AI.

We are looking for a strategic portfolio leader to shape and drive a global Automation portfolio within the Energy Industry division. This role sits at the intersection of technology, business strategy, innovation, and market growth, ensuring our portfolio remains competitive, scalable, and aligned with evolving customer needs.

As Head of Portfolio Management, you will define portfolio priorities, influence investment decisions, and guide the evolution of our automation, software, digital, and AI-enabled offerings. Working closely with executive leaders, Product Management, R&D, Sales, and Business Lines, you will help shape the future direction of one of the industry's leading automation portfolios.

*This job is open for worldwide global candidates - not restricted to the mentioned locations.
Relocation and Visa support is not allowed. If selected, you will be hosted in your country at the nearest ABB business location
The work model is: Hybrid


Main responsibilities:

  • Define and execute the portfolio strategy, aligning technology investments with business priorities, market opportunities, and customer value creation

  • Lead portfolio governance, prioritization, and investment decisions across a diverse portfolio of automation, software, digital, and AI-enabled solutions

  • Own portfolio performance, balancing growth, profitability, lifecycle maturity, and long-term competitiveness

  • Drive portfolio transformation by simplifying complexity, improving scalability, and strengthening portfolio differentiation

  • Align product roadmaps across multiple product lines and technologies, creating a coherent automation ecosystem

  • Partner with R&D, Sales, and Business Leadership to accelerate commercialization and market adoption

  • Translate market, customer, competitive, and technology insights into actionable portfolio strategies and investment cases

  • Safeguard and strengthen the portfolio’s intellectual property position by aligning innovation, technology differentiation, and competitive protection with portfolio strategy

  • Build and develop portfolio management capabilities while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Head of Technology & Innovation

__

Innovation is a key driver of the next phase of growth in industrial automation. As Head of Innovation within the Energy Industry division, you will shape the future beyond the existing portfolio by identifying breakthrough technologies, creating new growth platforms, and building an integrated automation and digital ecosystem that delivers measurable customer and business value.

This is a highly visible leadership role with broad influence across technology, product management, digital solutions, strategy, and external partners. You will transform ideas into scalable offerings, accelerate the development of future anchor products, strengthening intellectual property creation, and help define how industrial automation evolves in an increasingly digital and AI-enabled world.

*This job is open for worldwide global candidates - not restricted to the mentioned locations.
Relocation and Visa support is not allowed. If selected, you will be hosted in your country at the nearest ABB business location
The work model is: Hybrid


Main responsibilities:

  • Define and execute the innovation strategy aligned with long-term business growth priorities.

  • Identify, incubate, and scale new technologies, products, and business models within industrial automation and digital solutions.

  • Lead the end-to-end innovation pipeline from opportunity identification through validation and productization readiness.

  • Build and expand a connected ecosystem of strategic partners, including customers, technology providers, startups, and academic institutions.

  • Shape technology roadmaps and investment priorities for automation, digital, and AI-enabled solutions.

  • Drive intellectual property development, protection, and value creation through a structured innovation framework.

  • Translate emerging customer needs and market trends into differentiated offerings and future growth opportunities.

  • Foster a strong innovation culture and enable cross-functional collaboration across product management, R&D, digital, and commercial teams.

• Qualifications for the role:

  • 12+ years of experience within industrial automation, control systems, digital technologies, or closely related industrial technology sectors.

  • Proven success leading innovation, portfolio management, product management, or R&D initiatives in complex global organizations.

  • Proven experience in intellectual property management, including patent development, technology protection, and translating innovation into competitive differentiation.

  • Deep understanding of automation, software, digital platforms, data-driven solutions, and AI-enabled technologies.

  • Demonstrated experience building innovation pipelines, technology roadmaps, and new business opportunities from concept to market.

  • Track record of developing strategic partnerships and collaborating across industry ecosystems.

  • Experience driving intellectual property, patent development, or technology differentiation initiatives.

  • Effective customer and market orientation with the ability to connect technology innovation to business outcomes.

  • Global leadership experience with exceptional stakeholder management, collaboration, and communication skills.


*

This opportunity is open to candidates in multiple countries, with the final work location determined based on the selected candidate. As compensation may vary by location, we are committed to being transparent throughout the hiring process and will share details of the salary range, variable compensation and benefits package with candidates who progress to the first interview stage for a location in the European Union, covered by the EU Pay Transparency Directive.

The final offer will be tailored based on your role location, experience, skills and qualifications, internal market positioning and alignment with ABB internal standards.

jobs.title: Sales Support Specialist w/m/d (80-100%)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Sales Support Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will support ABB Switzerland’s local sales organization as well as our customers throughout the entire quotation process in the field of drive technology. You will act as the central technical point of contact within your area of responsibility and collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders on a daily basis.


• Your responsibilities include optimally sizing products for customers to best meet their requirements and applicable standards. In addition, you will calculate costs and prepare quotations with the relevant technical information. You will apply your technical expertise in a targeted manner and make a significant contribution to the successful preparation of proposals.


Work model: Hybrid


This position supports the local sales unit (Motion) in Baden, Canton Aargau.


Your main responsibilities

  • Technical consulting & solution development: You support sales and customers in selecting technically optimal and economically viable solutions for drive and automation systems.
  • End-to-end quotation management: You prepare and calculate technical and commercial quotations and support them through to successful completion.
  • Analysis & optimization: You analyze customer needs, market and competitor information, as well as lost opportunities, and derive targeted improvement measures.
  • Collaboration & quality assurance: You work closely with sales, business units, and other stakeholders and ensure compliance with quality, compliance, and HSE standards.

• Qualifications for the role

  • Completed technical education (e.g., automation technician, electronics technician, automation specialist, or similar)
  • Several years of professional experience (min. 5 years) in sales support, sales, or project environments
  • Very good German skills and good English skills, both written and spoken
  • Strong customer orientation and excellent communication skills
  • Analytical mindset and understanding of markets and processes
  • Initiative, structured way of working, and assertiveness
  • Advantageous: French language skills and further education at HF level (e.g., certified technician HF)

Benefits

• We offer, among others:

  • Employee share acquisition plan (ESAP)
  • REKA credit
  • Employee discounts (MyDiscounts / Swibeco)
  • Parental leave
  • Fitness allowance
  • Eco bonus

More about us

ABB Motion provides industrial customers with cutting-edge technologies, products, solutions, and related services to increase energy efficiency, improve safety and reliability, and ensure precise control of processes. The portfolio includes motors, generators, and drives for a wide range of applications across all industries.


The recruitment process is managed by Ece Özen, Talent Partner.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

jobs.title: (Senior) Research Scientist in Industrial Sensor Systems (80% - 100%) f/m/d
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Research Department Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

As a Research Scientist, you will be working on sensing solutions for ABB’s next generation systems and products. We are looking for a team member with a proven research track record and the eagerness to transfer and apply world class academic research into an industrial environment. You will work within the highly motivated, international team of scientists at ABB Research. • We offer an open and innovative work environment with many diverse opportunities to grow your career.

The work model for the role is: #LI-hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Contributing to and leading research projects in the field of sensors and industrial sensing applications addressing the needs of our businesses, with applications including automation, process industries, and electrification.
  • Together with multidisciplinary project teams, develop novel, high-value sensing products and solutions from the concept definition phase to the experimental verification.
  • Evaluate new technologies and conduct technical surveys, generate project proposals with business impact and collaborate with researchers and engineers from other research centers, ABB business units, as well as from universities.
  • Disseminate your results with scientific publications and internal technical reports, generate intellectual property.


• Qualifications for the role

  • PhD university degree in electrical engineering, computer science, or related field
  • Theoretical and practical knowledge in signal processing and data analytics (including ML/deep-learning-based) e.g. denoising, feature extraction, time-series analysis and anomaly detection, signal classification and pattern recognition
  • Hands-on experience with test, design, simulation and validation of electronic systems, embedded electronics, (wireless-) connectivity, testing methodologies and data-driven validation, edge/embedded ML deployment
  • Solid experience of getting ideas from concepts to prototypes
  • Strong interest in sensing technologies and integration of sensors in systems. Context knowledge in electrification-related applications considered as a plus
  • Proficiency in one or more programming languages (C/C++, Python, Matlab and modern ML frameworks -PyTorch-), and use of coding agents
  • Excellent communication skills and team player attitude and excellent command (written & oral) of the English language

More about us

The ABB Research Center located in Baden-Dättwil, Switzerland, is where we investigate new technologies which support and drive the development of ABB’s next-generation products and solutions. Our international research teams focus on Power Electronics, Energy Storage, Intelligent Systems, and Switching.

We look forward to receiving your application, including CV, cover letter and list of publications. If you want to discover more about ABB, take another look at our website www.abb.com. This position is managed by Pedro Labian (Talent Acquisition Partner at ABB Switzerland).

As a Research Scientist, you will be working on sensing solutions for ABB’s next generation systems and products. We are looking for a team member with a proven research track record and the eagerness to transfer and apply world class academic research into an industrial environment. You will work within the highly motivated, international team of scientists at ABB Research. • We offer an open and innovative work environment with many diverse opportunities to grow your career.

The work model for the role is: #LI-hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Contributing to and leading research projects in the field of sensors and industrial sensing applications addressing the needs of our businesses, with applications including automation, process industries, and electrification.
  • Together with multidisciplinary project teams, develop novel, high-value sensing products and solutions from the concept definition phase to the experimental verification.
  • Evaluate new technologies and conduct technical surveys, generate project proposals with business impact and collaborate with researchers and engineers from other research centers, ABB business units, as well as from universities.
  • Disseminate your results with scientific publications and internal technical reports, generate intellectual property.


• Qualifications for the role

  • PhD university degree in electrical engineering, computer science, or related field
  • Theoretical and practical knowledge in signal processing and data analytics (including ML/deep-learning-based) e.g. denoising, feature extraction, time-series analysis and anomaly detection, signal classification and pattern recognition
  • Hands-on experience with test, design, simulation and validation of electronic systems, embedded electronics, (wireless-) connectivity, testing methodologies and data-driven validation, edge/embedded ML deployment
  • Solid experience of getting ideas from concepts to prototypes
  • Strong interest in sensing technologies and integration of sensors in systems. Context knowledge in electrification-related applications considered as a plus
  • Proficiency in one or more programming languages (C/C++, Python, Matlab and modern ML frameworks -PyTorch-), and use of coding agents
  • Excellent communication skills and team player attitude and excellent command (written & oral) of the English language

More about us

The ABB Research Center located in Baden-Dättwil, Switzerland, is where we investigate new technologies which support and drive the development of ABB’s next-generation products and solutions. Our international research teams focus on Power Electronics, Energy Storage, Intelligent Systems, and Switching.

We look forward to receiving your application, including CV, cover letter and list of publications. If you want to discover more about ABB, take another look at our website www.abb.com. This position is managed by Pedro Labian (Talent Acquisition Partner at ABB Switzerland).

This position reports to:

Project Operations Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this versatile role, you will be responsible for the successful execution of customer projects involving medium-voltage switchgear and other electrical engineering solutions for the Swiss market. You will manage your projects from order handover through delivery and successful completion, acting as the central point of contact for our customers.

You will work closely with the project and engineering teams at our international supply factories as well as with local specialist functions. You will manage a portfolio of projects of varying sizes and ensure compliance with schedule, cost, quality, and contractual requirements.

The work model for this position is: Hybrid #LI-hybrid

This position is part of the Medium Voltage Switchgear business within the Electrification Distribution Solutions division in Switzerland.

Your main responsibilities

  • End-to-end project responsibility: Manage multiple customer projects from order handover through delivery and completion, representing ABB as the central point of contact for our customers.

  • Planning and coordination: Plan and manage schedules, scope of supply, and interfaces, while coordinating collaboration with international supply factories, factory project managers, engineering, production, logistics, and local partners.

  • Commercial project management: Monitor project costs, risks, changes, and claims, identify deviations at an early stage, and implement appropriate actions in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders.

  • Project close-out and continuous improvement: Take responsibility for customer acceptance, project documentation, and commercial close-out, and actively contribute your experience and lessons learned to the continuous improvement of our project execution processes.

• Qualifications for the role:

  • At least three years of experience independently managing multiple customer projects, with demonstrated end-to-end responsibility for projects of appropriate technical and organizational complexity.

  • Demonstrated professional experience with electrical installations, electrical products, or electrical system solutions. A qualification or degree in electrical engineering and experience with medium-voltage switchgear are considered an advantage.

  • Proven practical ability to manage schedules, costs, risks, changes, and interfaces in an industrial, customer-focused, and delivery-oriented environment.

  • Very good German and English skills, enabling you to independently and confidently conduct demanding customer discussions, manage escalations, and handle commercial and contractual negotiations.

  • A structured, independent, and pragmatic way of working, combined with the ability to prioritize and transparently manage multiple projects of varying sizes and to take a solution-oriented approach when deviations occur.

  • Practical knowledge of commonly used project management and collaboration tools. An entry-level project management certification or a comparable qualification is expected. Applicants with demonstrated practical project management experience and a willingness to complete the certification through our internal project management program will also be considered

More about us

ABB's Distribution Solutions division provides medium voltage components, switchgear, and solutions that connect and protect the evolving electrical grid, ensuring reliable and predictable energy distribution. We link high-voltage systems to medium and low-voltage consumers, ensuring continuous power delivery to industrial, commercial, and residential users while enabling the integration of renewable energy sources into the grid. Our smart solutions, powered by AI, enhance grid resilience and optimize the usage of the electrical system.
With ABB Ability™ enabled connected solutions, the offering includes medium-voltage air- and gas-insulated switchgear (1 to 46 kV), indoor and outdoor circuit breakers, protection relays, instrument transformers, sensors and solutions for distribution stations.
We support our customers and partners in staying ahead of increasing electrification needs, technology, and regulatory changes, providing the power to adapt to a rapidly evolving energy landscape.

We look forward to receiving your application (documents submitted in English are appreciated). The recruiting process is being led by Reto Korstick, Talent Partner at ABB Switzerland Ltd. If you want to discover more about ABB, take another look at our website www.abb.com.

jobs.title: Digital Technology Manager
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Sub GBU Technology Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

As Digital Technology Manager you will be responsible for leading the development and execution of the digital technology roadmap for the ELSE division. This strategic role leads digital innovation and the evolution of the division’s global digital portfolio. The position bridges business strategy with technology implementation, ensuring that the ELSE division achieves its future growth targets and leadership in digital.

The preferred work model for this role is hybrid, although remote work is also acceptable.

This role is contributing to the Global R&D of ELSE Division. Main stakeholders are R&D Technology Manager, Digital Lead and Product Managementt.

You will be mainly accountable for:
  • Define and evolve the global technology roadmap for digital products, Cloud software, software tools, and embedded systems in close collaboration with Digital Lead, Digital Transformation Manager, Product Line Managers, and Product Managers
  • Collaborate with R&D Team Managers to ensure appropriate competences in the teams and properly defined objectives in line with the overall R&D strategy
  • Identify emerging technologies together with the R&D and Corporate Research teams and drive collaboration and knowledge transfer
  • Manage investments, resources, key risks, and relevant IP in the area of responsibility.
  • Drive innovation, define technology standards and guide architectural decisions for the digital platforms of the division
  • Establish common development processes, tools, architecture principles, and quality standards across teams.
  • Coordinate local and global teams and partners, ensuring that appropriate actions and decisions are taken to manage conflicts or resolve technical problems.

• Qualifications for the role
  • Master's degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or related discipline
  • 10+ years in digital technology management role with experience in defining technology roadmaps and leading complex development portfolios
  • Sound experience in leading development process from requirements to product launch. Mastery in Agile methodologies and experience in Gate Model or equivalent process
  • Solid knowledge of cloud platforms (Azure preferred) and system architecture
  • Understanding of IoT, edge computing, and industrial automation technologies
  • Ability to influence without authority in matrix organizations and to work across countries and cultures
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent project and program management abilities
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. Fluent in English, both written and spoken
  • Availability to travel is required, estimated up to 20% travel



More about us

ABB's Service Division partners with our customers to improve the availability, reliability, predictability and sustainability of electrical products and installations. The Division’s extensive service portfolio offers product care, modernization, and advisory services to improve performance, extend equipment lifetime and deliver new levels of operational and sustainable efficiency. We help customers keep resources in use for as long as possible, extracting the maximum value from them, and then recovering and regenerating products and materials at the end of their useful life.

Join us. Be part of the team where progress happens, industries transform, and your work shapes the world. Run What Runs the World.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

This position reports to:

Sub GBU Technology Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

As Digital Technology Manager you will be responsible for leading the development and execution of the digital technology roadmap for the ELSE division. This strategic role leads digital innovation and the evolution of the division’s global digital portfolio. The position bridges business strategy with technology implementation, ensuring that the ELSE division achieves its future growth targets and leadership in digital.

The preferred work model for this role is hybrid, although remote work is also acceptable.

This role is contributing to the Global R&D of ELSE Division. Main stakeholders are R&D Technology Manager, Digital Lead and Product Managementt.

You will be mainly accountable for:
  • Define and evolve the global technology roadmap for digital products, Cloud software, software tools, and embedded systems in close collaboration with Digital Lead, Digital Transformation Manager, Product Line Managers, and Product Managers
  • Collaborate with R&D Team Managers to ensure appropriate competences in the teams and properly defined objectives in line with the overall R&D strategy
  • Identify emerging technologies together with the R&D and Corporate Research teams and drive collaboration and knowledge transfer
  • Manage investments, resources, key risks, and relevant IP in the area of responsibility.
  • Drive innovation, define technology standards and guide architectural decisions for the digital platforms of the division
  • Establish common development processes, tools, architecture principles, and quality standards across teams.
  • Coordinate local and global teams and partners, ensuring that appropriate actions and decisions are taken to manage conflicts or resolve technical problems.

• Qualifications for the role
  • Master's degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or related discipline
  • 10+ years in digital technology management role with experience in defining technology roadmaps and leading complex development portfolios
  • Sound experience in leading development process from requirements to product launch. Mastery in Agile methodologies and experience in Gate Model or equivalent process
  • Solid knowledge of cloud platforms (Azure preferred) and system architecture
  • Understanding of IoT, edge computing, and industrial automation technologies
  • Ability to influence without authority in matrix organizations and to work across countries and cultures
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent project and program management abilities
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. Fluent in English, both written and spoken
  • Availability to travel is required, estimated up to 20% travel



More about us

The Division’s extensive service portfolio offers product care, modernization, and advisory services to improve performance, extend equipment lifetime and deliver new levels of operational and sustainable efficiency. Join us. Be part of the team where progress happens, industries transform, and your work shapes the world. Run What Runs the World.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.title: Marketing & Communication Specialist (80-100%)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Marketing & Communications Leader

__

Your role and responsibilities

Do you thrive on turning big ideas into memorable live marketing experiences? We are looking for a Marketing Allrounder with a focus on events for the Swiss market who combines strong customer focus, compelling storytelling, smart budget management, and seamless execution.

With a genuine interest in technical products, you know how to translate our solutions into engaging messages that resonate with local target audiences and address market needs. As a hands-on team player with a strong performance mindset, you are comfortable managing multiple priorities and rolling up your sleeves to make things happen. Creating impact across both physical and digital touchpoints comes naturally to you.

In this role, you will work closely with our local Sales and Product Marketing teams, as well as with a dynamic Marketing & Communications team that is passionate about creating impact.

The work model for the role is: hybrid

This role reports to the Marketing & Communications Manager for the Electrification Business Area in Switzerland.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Bringing live marketing experiences to life by planning and delivering small to big customer events and trade shows from concept through execution and evaluation.

  • Leveraging our CRM and Account Engagement tools to support campaign execution, audience engagement, lead management, and performance tracking.

  • Managing agencies and external partners, ensuring high-quality delivery on time and within budget.

  • Localizing global campaigns for the Swiss market and activating them across relevant digital channels, adapting content, messaging, and assets to local audiences and market needs.

• Qualifications for the role:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field.

  • Approximately 5–8 years of experience in marketing and event management, preferably within a B2B or industrial environment. An established industry network is considered a advantage.

  • Native-level German, fluency in English, and very good proficiency in French.

  • Experience sourcing, negotiating with, and managing suppliers and partners.

  • Excellent time-management, organizational, and multitasking skills.

  • Outstanding communication and stakeholder-management skills, with a collaborative and solution-oriented approach.

  • Demonstrated ability to leverage AI in daily marketing to streamline workflows, enhance content, and improve customer experiences.

More about us

ABB Electrification is a global technology leader enabling the efficient and reliable distribution of electricity from source to socket. With more than 50,000 employees across 100 countries, we collaborate with our customers and partners to solve the world’s greatest challenges in electrical distribution and energy management. As the energy transition accelerates and electricity demands grow, we are electrifying the world in a safe, smart and sustainable way. At ABB, we are ‘Engineered to Outrun’, and we are passionate about helping our customers and partners do the same.

The recruitment process is being led by Reto Korstick, Talent & Acquisition Partner.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.title: Translatable Text Senior Accounting & Reporting Analyst General Accounting (f/m/d) 80-100%
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

R2R Manager CH & HQ

__

Your role and responsibilities
In this role, you will have the opportunity to provide accounting, reporting, and consolidation expertise. Each day, you will support in accounting and reporting matters to business/reporting units through resolution of accounting and reporting questions, financial statement preparation and review follow-up on accounting issues. You will also showcase your expertise by supporting in the preparation of financial reports in compliance with internal guidelines, procedures, and external regulatory requirements. You will be the business process owner of the local R2R process and the main speaking partner for internal and external auditors.

The work model for the role is: hybrid


This role is contributing to the MO Finance CoE and Front Office / Motion Finance in Baden, Switzerland. Main stakeholders are Company Controllers, Group Reporting and financial Managers.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Manage and ensure the accuracy of general accounting activities, including pension and lease accounting, supporting reliable financial reporting and transparency.
  • Act as the local Record-to-Report (R2R) Business Process Owner, driving effective internal controls, supporting testing activities, and fostering cross-functional collaboration across diverse teams.
  • Ensure compliance with US GAAP, Swiss GAAP, and ABB policies, performing quality reviews, analyzing financial data, and partnering with internal and external auditors to maintain high reporting standards.
  • Investigate, reconcile, and resolve accounting and reporting matters, working closely with stakeholders from different functions and backgrounds to identify solutions and support continuous improvement.


You will join a small, experienced, and dynamic team that is always committed to providing the best services to our internal customers.


 • Qualifications for the role

  • Proven experience in Finance and Accounting, with a strong background in General Accounting, Financial Reporting and/or process improvement initiatives.
  • Strong knowledge of internal controls and governance requirements, ideally within the Record-to-Report (R2R) process.
  • Solid experience working with SAP FI/CO; knowledge of Hyperion and SAP BW is an advantage.
  • Advanced Excel skills and a data-driven approach to financial analysis and reporting.
  • Sound understanding of Swiss GAAP and US GAAP accounting standards.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a structured, accurate and quality-focused way of working.
  • Degree in Economics, Finance, Business Administration or a related field, and/or a recognized professional qualification in Finance and Accounting.
  • Fluency in German and English, with the ability to communicate effectively and collaborate with diverse stakeholders in an international environment.

Benefits
We also offer our employees the following benefits:

  • Employee share acquisition plan (ESAP)
  • REKA credit
  • Employee discounts (MyDiscounts / Swibeco)
  • Parental leave
  • Fitness allowance
  • Eco bonus


More about us

ABB Finance is a trusted partner to the business and a world-class team who delivers forward-looking insights that drive sustainable long-term results and operates with the highest standards.

This recruitment process is led by Talent Partner, Ece Özen, ABB Switzerland Ltd.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Sales Manager

Dans cette position de vente dynamique, vous dirigerez le développement du marché avec les fabricants de commutateurs à travers la région nord-ouest de la Suisse germanophone.   • Fond d'expérience technique avec une formation ou des études pertinentes dans le domaine de l'ingénierie électrique et de la distribution d'électricité

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Service Sales Manager

__

In this role, you will have the opportunity to develop service sales, from lead generation, service sales opportunities creation until securing the profitable sales within the designated areas. Each day, you will focus on Installed Base (IB) and sell the entire Service portfolio. You will also showcase your skills by building long-term customer relationships and ensuring immediate response to specific customer needs and issues.

The work model for the role is hybrid.

This role contributes to the Service of Mining and Materials Business Line within the Automation Process Industries division in a defined global region.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Penetrating into IB, promoting various upgrades, retrofits, and value-add services to the benefit of the customers and ABB.
  • Understanding the channel strategy and the establishment of related prices, preparing sales plans, reviewing them, and proposing recovery plan(s) when needed.
  • Generating service sales leads and developing new market opportunities by utilizing market trend information and through identifying and exploring potential new service portfolios.
  • Acting as a marketer/salesperson of ABB’s service products and solutions during marketing activities (campaigns, trade fairs, exhibitions, conferences, customer meetings).


Our team dynamics
You will join an international collaborative team working in a changing business environment, where you will be able to thrive.


• Qualifications for the role

  • Degree in Engineering Disciplines, Business Administration or similar and 5+ years of experience in the mining business. Experience in service sales or similar roles is very beneficial
  • You are highly motivated and enjoy working in agile market and you’re willing to travel up to 30% worldwide
  • Demonstrated experience in managing global accounts, increasing sales growth, and complex negotiations
  • Solid stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work with cross-functional teams and customers
  • Solid data-driven pipeline & forecasting discipline (e.g., SFDC)
  • Experience with digital sales enablement, customer demonstrations, and lifecycle-service offerings are advantages.
  • Proven tender/pursuit leadership up to complex, high-value solution deals
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills, with fluency in English and German

Benefits
We also offer our employees the following benefits:

  • Flexible working hours
  • Learning and growth opportunities
  • Career growth opportunities
  • Generous vacation allowance


More about us
We help the mining industry become safer, leaner, and more sustainable by combining electrification, automation, and digital technologies with over 130 years of experience.
Our comprehensive mining services portfolio - ranging from engineering and maintenance to digital and lifecycle solutions - supports customers in maximizing asset performance and availability.
Together with our customers, we deliver tailored, data-driven solutions that enable reliable operations today while shaping the future of the all-electric, connected mine.

The recruitment process is led by Ceren Özen, Talent Acquisition Team Lead, ABB Switzerland Ltd.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Manager Production Development

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to optimize the Production organization’s assembly methods, processes, and equipment to minimize labor hours in accordance with business strategies related to quality, efficiency, costs, and safety. Each day, you will ensure appropriate production methods, cycle time, equipment performance, and materials/components in support of production targets. You will also showcase your expertise by defining the working phase sequence of a new production process to achieve the targeted product cost and equipment investment budget.

The work model for the role is onsite.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Drive process optimization and digitalization initiatives across Battery and Converter Production by analyzing and improving production processes, shopfloor workflows, and the interaction between machines, systems, and operators.

  • Manage and further develop production data, reporting solutions, and manufacturing systems, including MES, ERP, smart tools, Power BI, and related applications.

  • Support the reliability of digital shopfloor infrastructure and provide hands-on troubleshooting for manufacturing equipment, OT systems, industrial networks, interfaces, and other production systems.

  • Support the transition from engineering to manufacturing and coordinate the implementation, testing, rollout, documentation, and training of manufacturing solutions, including product data flows, PLM processes, BOM transformations, and design guidelines.


• Qualifications for the role

  • University degree in engineering or a related technical field, or a strong technical background combined with relevant industrial experience, for example in production, assembly, testing, or maintenance.

  • Basic digital know-how and a strong interest in digital manufacturing, production systems, PLM topics, and the use of 3D models in manufacturing processes.

  • Practical understanding of industrial operations and shopfloor requirements, ideally within battery or converter manufacturing.

  • Ability to analyze production processes, workflows, manufacturing machines, and production plants, identify improvement potential, and translate findings into structured and practical solutions.

  • Interest in production data analysis and familiarity with manufacturing systems such as MES, ERP, Power BI, smart tools, OT systems, or industrial networks.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively with Production, Engineering, Maintenance, IT, and other stakeholders. Fluency in German and English is required.

  • High motivation, curiosity, and willingness to take responsibility; basic knowledge of BOM structures, PLM processes, or troubleshooting of digital shopfloor systems is an advantage.



More about us

The ABB Traction Division is a recognized market leader in drive technologies for rail vehicles, buses, and industrial vehicles, driving innovation in electrification.

Our comprehensive portfolio of high-performance traction, auxiliary, and energy storage solutions – all managed across the entire life cycle – helps to improve energy efficiency and make transportation more sustainable.

Together, we make a difference for our customers every single day. We look forward to receiving your application.

The recruitment process is led by Talent Acquisition Partner Gema de Vicente.

#ABBCareers

#RunwithABB

#Runwhatrunstheworld

• Ihre Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten

In dieser Position haben Sie die Möglichkeit, die Montagemethoden, Prozesse und Anlagen der Produktionsorganisation zu optimieren, um den Arbeitsaufwand im Einklang mit den Unternehmensstrategien hinsichtlich Qualität, Effizienz, Kosten und Sicherheit zu minimieren. Sie stellen täglich sicher, dass geeignete Produktionsmethoden, Zykluszeiten, Anlagenleistungen sowie Materialien und Komponenten zur Erreichung der Produktionsziele eingesetzt werden. Darüber hinaus bringen Sie Ihre Expertise ein, indem Sie die Arbeitsabläufe neuer Produktionsprozesse definieren, um die angestrebten Produktkosten und das Investitionsbudget für Anlagen einzuhalten.

Der Arbeitsort für diese Position ist vor Ort.

Zu Ihren Hauptaufgaben gehören:

  • Vorantreiben von Prozessoptimierungs- und Digitalisierungsinitiativen in der Batterie- und Konverterproduktion durch Analyse und Verbesserung von Produktionsprozessen, Shopfloor-Abläufen sowie der Interaktion zwischen Maschinen, Systemen und Mitarbeitenden.

  • Verwaltung und Weiterentwicklung von Produktionsdaten, Reporting-Lösungen und Manufacturing-Systemen, einschließlich MES, ERP, Smart Tools, Power BI und verwandter Anwendungen.

  • Sicherstellung der Zuverlässigkeit der digitalen Shopfloor-Infrastruktur sowie praktische Unterstützung bei der Fehleranalyse und Störungsbehebung von Produktionsanlagen, OT-Systemen, industriellen Netzwerken, Schnittstellen und weiteren Produktionssystemen.

  • Unterstützung des Übergangs von der Entwicklung in die Fertigung sowie Koordination der Implementierung, Tests, Einführung, Dokumentation und Schulung von Fertigungslösungen, einschließlich Produktdatenflüssen, PLM-Prozessen, Stücklisten-Transformationen (BOM) und Konstruktionsrichtlinien.

Qualifikationen für diese Position

  • Hochschulabschluss im Ingenieurwesen oder einem verwandten technischen Fachgebiet oder ein fundierter technischer Hintergrund kombiniert mit einschlägiger Industrieerfahrung, beispielsweise in Produktion, Montage, Prüfung oder Instandhaltung.

  • Grundlegendes digitales Know-how sowie großes Interesse an digitaler Fertigung, Produktionssystemen, PLM-Themen und dem Einsatz von 3D-Modellen in Fertigungsprozessen.

  • Praktisches Verständnis industrieller Abläufe und Produktionsanforderungen, idealerweise im Bereich Batterie- oder Konverterfertigung.

  • Fähigkeit, Produktionsprozesse, Arbeitsabläufe, Fertigungsmaschinen und Produktionsanlagen zu analysieren, Verbesserungspotenziale zu identifizieren und die Erkenntnisse in strukturierte und praxisnahe Lösungen umzusetzen.

  • Interesse an der Analyse von Produktionsdaten sowie Kenntnisse von Fertigungssystemen wie MES, ERP, Power BI, Smart Tools, OT-Systemen oder industriellen Netzwerken.

  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeiten sowie die Fähigkeit zur effektiven Zusammenarbeit mit Produktion, Engineering, Instandhaltung, IT und weiteren Stakeholdern. Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sind erforderlich.

  • Hohe Motivation, Neugier und Bereitschaft, Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Grundkenntnisse in Stücklistenstrukturen (BOM), PLM-Prozessen oder der Fehlerbehebung digitaler Shopfloor-Systeme sind von Vorteil.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Sarete autorizzati a guidare, sostenuto per crescere, e orgoglioso dell'impatto che creiamo insieme. Unisciti a noi e aiuta a gestire il mondo. In questo ruolo, avrete l'opportunità di ottimizzare i metodi di assemblaggio, i processi e le attrezzature dell'organizzazione di produzione per ridurre al minimo le ore di lavoro in conformità con le strategie aziendali relative alla qualità, efficienza, costi e sicurezza. Ogni giorno, vi assicurerete i metodi di produzione appropriati, il tempo di ciclo, le prestazioni delle attrezzature e materiali/componenti a sostegno degli obiettivi di produzione. Potrai anche mostrare la tua esperienza definendo la sequenza di fase di lavoro di un nuovo processo di produzione per raggiungere il budget di investimento mirato dei costi del prodotto e delle attrezzature. Il modello di lavoro per il ruolo è in loco. Sarete principalmente responsabili per: Accelerare le iniziative di ottimizzazione e digitalizzazione del processo attraverso la produzione di batterie e convertitori analizzando e migliorando i processi di produzione, i flussi di lavoro del laboratorio e l'interazione tra macchine, sistemi e operatori. Gestire e sviluppare ulteriormente i dati di produzione, le soluzioni di reporting e i sistemi di produzione, tra cui MES, ERP, strumenti intelligenti, Power BI e applicazioni correlate. Sostenere l'affidabilità dell'infrastruttura digitale del pavimento del negozio e fornire la risoluzione dei problemi hands-on per le attrezzature di produzione, sistemi OT, reti industriali, interfacce e altri sistemi di produzione. Sostenere la transizione dall'ingegneria alla produzione e coordinare l'implementazione, il collaudo, la documentazione e la formazione di soluzioni di produzione, compresi i flussi di dati di prodotto, i processi PLM, le trasformazioni BOM e le linee guida di progettazione. • Qualifiche per il ruolo Conoscenza digitale di base e un forte interesse per la produzione digitale, i sistemi di produzione, gli argomenti PLM e l'uso di modelli 3D nei processi produttivi. Capacità di analizzare i processi di produzione, i flussi di lavoro, le macchine di produzione e gli impianti di produzione, identificare il potenziale di miglioramento e tradurre i risultati in soluzioni strutturate e pratiche. Interessi nell'analisi dei dati di produzione e familiarità con sistemi di produzione come MES, ERP, Power BI, strumenti intelligenti, sistemi OT o reti industriali. Forte capacità di comunicazione e collaborazione, con la capacità di coordinare efficacemente con Produzione, Ingegneria, Manutenzione, IT e altri stakeholder. È necessaria una fluidità in tedesco e inglese. L'alta motivazione, la curiosità e la volontà di assumersi la responsabilità; la conoscenza di base delle strutture BOM, dei processi PLM, o la risoluzione dei problemi dei sistemi digital shopfloor è un vantaggio. La ABB Traction Division è leader di mercato riconosciuto nelle tecnologie di azionamento per veicoli ferroviari, autobus e veicoli industriali, che guidano l'innovazione nell'elettrificazione. Il nostro portafoglio completo di soluzioni di trazione, ausilio e stoccaggio energetico ad alte prestazioni, tutte gestite in tutto il ciclo di vita, contribuisce a migliorare l'efficienza energetica e rendere il trasporto più sostenibile. À ABB, nous aidons les industries à fonctionner plus minces et plus propres. Vous aurez le pouvoir de diriger, de soutenir la croissance et d'être fiers de l'impact que nous créons ensemble. Rejoignez-nous et aidez-nous à exécuter ce qui dirige le monde.

Cette position fait rapport à:

Développement de la production des gestionnaires

Votre rôle et responsabilités

Dans ce rôle, vous aurez la possibilité d'optimiser les méthodes d'assemblage de l'organisation de production, les processus et l'équipement pour minimiser les heures de travail conformément aux stratégies d'affaires liées à la qualité, l'efficacité, les coûts et la sécurité. Chaque jour, vous assurerez les méthodes de production, le temps de cycle, la performance de l'équipement et les matériaux/composants appropriés à l'appui des objectifs de production. Vous présenterez également votre expertise en définissant la séquence de la phase de travail d'un nouveau processus de production pour atteindre le budget d'investissement ciblé en matière de coûts et d'équipement.

Le modèle de travail pour le rôle est sur place.

Vous serez principalement responsable de :

  • Mettre en oeuvre des initiatives d'optimisation des processus et de numérisation dans l'ensemble de la production de piles et de convertisseurs en analysant et en améliorant les processus de production, les flux de travail et l'interaction entre les machines, les systèmes et les opérateurs.

  • Gérer et développer davantage les données de production, les solutions de déclaration et les systèmes de fabrication, y compris le MES, le PGI, les outils intelligents, le Power BI et les applications connexes.

  • Soutenir la fiabilité de l'infrastructure d'atelier numérique et fournir un dépannage pratique pour les équipements de fabrication, les systèmes OT, les réseaux industriels, les interfaces et autres systèmes de production.

  • Appuyer la transition de l'ingénierie à la fabrication et coordonner la mise en oeuvre, la mise à l'essai, le déploiement, la documentation et la formation des solutions de fabrication, y compris les flux de données sur les produits, les processus PLM, les transformations BOM et les lignes directrices de conception.


• Qualifications pour le rôle

  • Diplôme universitaire en génie ou dans un domaine technique connexe, ou une solide expérience technique associée à une expérience industrielle pertinente, par exemple en production, en montage, en essai ou en maintenance.

  • Le savoir-faire numérique de base et un vif intérêt pour la fabrication numérique, les systèmes de production, les sujets de PLM et l'utilisation de modèles 3D dans les processus de fabrication.

  • Compréhension pratique des opérations industrielles et des exigences de l'atelier, idéalement dans la fabrication de piles ou de convertisseurs.

  • Capacité d'analyser les processus de production, les flux de travail, les machines de fabrication et les usines de production, de déterminer le potentiel d'amélioration et de traduire les résultats en solutions structurées et pratiques.

  • Intérêt pour l'analyse des données de production et la connaissance des systèmes de fabrication tels que MES, ERP, Power BI, des outils intelligents, des systèmes OT ou des réseaux industriels.

  • Fortes compétences en communication et en collaboration, avec la capacité de coordonner efficacement avec la production, l'ingénierie, la maintenance, les TI et d'autres intervenants. La maîtrise de l'allemand et de l'anglais est requise.

  • La grande motivation, la curiosité et la volonté de prendre des responsabilités; la connaissance de base des structures du BOM, des processus du PLM ou du dépannage des systèmes numériques d'atelier sont un avantage.

La Division de la traction ABB est un leader reconnu sur le marché des technologies d'entraînement pour les véhicules ferroviaires, les autobus et les véhicules industriels. Notre portefeuille complet de solutions de traction, auxiliaires et de stockage d'énergie de haute performance – toutes gérées tout au long du cycle de vie – contribue à améliorer l'efficacité énergétique et à rendre le transport plus durable.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Global Communications Manager - BL Mining & Materials

__

An opportunity has become available in ABB Swizterland as Marketing and Communications Specialist for our division Process Industries. In addition, 30% of the role will include leading assigned projects for the Global Business Line Mining & Materials.

The role holder is an enthusiastic team player, creative, proactive and self-motivated, and is familiar with digital marketing and marketing automation tools.

Reporting to the Global Business Line Communications and Marketing Manager for Mining & Materials, you work closely with the Local Management and Sales Teams and the Business Line Communications Leads to develop, localize and implement integrated marketing communications initiatives and campaigns to promote ABB’s portfolio and references to key stakeholders, including customers, trade media, influencers and employees.

The work model for the role is: hybrid

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to propose and implement communication plans. Each day, you will implement assigned marketing communications activities through all available communications tools according to group guidelines, directives, and messages, within the approved budget. You will also showcase your expertise by generating leads via advertising, sponsorship, and other promotional activities, using the internet as a hub for integrated marketing communications.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Act as a strategic communications partner to local management, identifying and driving internal and external communication priorities and opportunities, ensuring alignment with divisional objectives, with a strong focus on employee engagement, sales enablement and thought leadership

  • Lead internal communications and employee engagement, including town halls, leadership communications, internal channels, content creation, and employee recognition initiatives

  • Support sales and business growth through communications, developing sales materials, presentations, customer success stories, references, and other collateral that strengthen customer engagement, market visibility, and business results

  • Support global marketing and communications (30% of the role) for a designated product line within the Mining & Materials portfolio, by leading thought leadership, lead nurturing initiatives, product launches, sales enablement and social media presence


• Qualifications for the role

  • University’s degree preferably in journalism / communication / marketing / or related field

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in marketing communications, ideally in communication agency or related B2B industries

  • Strong project management skills with the ability to manage several projects at the same time

  • Excellent communication skills (verbal and written) in English with ability to explain technology in an easy and engaging way with strong writing, editing and proofreading capabilities

  • Creative personality and innovative mindset with the capacity to come with new and fresh ideas, while ensuring consistency with brand and BL positioning

  • A solution-focused and self-starter mindset combined with passion for strategic and analytical thinking

  • Knowledge of digital marketing and marketing automation (SalesForce, Pardot, etc)



More about us

Process Industries division delivers complete electrification and automation solutions, industry-specific products and lifecycle services across industries. Engineering and delivering automation solutions from device to monitoring and control make our customers get more out of their investment; digitalization solutions including collaborative operations and augmented reality help improve plant and enterprise productivity, reduce maintenance and energy costs. Our engineering, project management, services and solutions portfolio covers a wide range of industries - Mining, Pulp & Paper, Metals, Aluminum and Cement, Data centers and Food and Beverage.

The recruitment process is supported by Talent Partner Gema de Vicente.

Ce poste relève de :

Global Communications Manager - BL Mining & Materials

Une opportunité est devenue disponible à ABB Swizterland en tant que spécialiste du marketing et des communications pour notre division Process Industries. De plus, 30 % du rôle consistera à diriger les projets assignés au secteur d'activité mondial de l'exploitation minière et des matériaux. Le titulaire du rôle est un acteur enthousiaste de l'équipe, créatif, proactif et automotivé, et il est familier avec les outils numériques de marketing et d'automatisation du marketing.

En faisant rapport au gestionnaire des communications et du marketing du secteur d'activité mondial pour l'exploitation minière et les matériaux, vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de gestion et de vente locales et le secteur d'activité Communications Dirige l'élaboration, la localisation et la mise en oeuvre d'initiatives et de campagnes intégrées de communication du marketing pour promouvoir le portefeuille et les références des principaux intervenants, y compris les clients, les médias commerciaux, les influenceurs et les employés.

Le modèle de travail pour le rôle est : hybride

Votre rôle et responsabilités

Dans ce rôle, vous aurez la possibilité de proposer et de mettre en œuvre des plans de communication. Chaque jour, vous mettrez en oeuvre les activités de communication marketing assignées à travers tous les outils de communication disponibles selon les lignes directrices, directives et messages de groupe, dans le budget approuvé. Vous mettrez également en valeur votre expertise en générant des pistes par le biais de la publicité, du parrainage et d'autres activités promotionnelles, en utilisant Internet comme centre de communications marketing intégrées.

Vous serez principalement responsable :

  • En tant que partenaire stratégique en matière de communications auprès de la direction locale Soutenir la commercialisation et les communications mondiales (30 % du rôle)pour une gamme de produits désignée au sein du portefeuille des mines et matériaux, par le leadership de la pensée, les initiatives de soutien de premier plan, les lancements de produits, l'habilitation des ventes et la présence sur les médias sociaux


• Qualifications pour le rôle

  • Université Diplôme de préférence en journalisme, communication, marketing ou domaine connexe

  • Minimum 5 années d'expérience en communication marketing, idéalement dans les agences de communication ou les industries connexes du B2B

  • Fort compétences en gestion de projet avec la capacité de gérer plusieurs projets en même temps

  • Excellentes compétences en communication (verbale et écrite) en anglais avec la capacité d'expliquer la technologie de façon facile et engageante grâce à de solides capacités d'écriture, d'édition et de correction

  • Personnalité créative et état d'esprit novateur avec la capacité de venir avec des idées nouvelles et nouvelles, tout en assurant la cohérence avec la marque et le positionnement BL

  • Un état d'esprit axé sur la solution et auto-démarrant combiné avec la passion pour la pensée stratégique et analytique

  • Connaissance de la commercialisation numérique et de l'automatisation du marketing (SalesForce, Pardot, etc.)


En savoir plus sur nous

Process Industries division offre des solutions complètes d'électrification et d'automatisation, des produits spécifiques à l'industrie et des services de cycle de vie dans toutes les industries. L'ingénierie et la fourniture de solutions d'automatisation de l'appareil à la surveillance et au contrôle font que nos clients tirent davantage parti de leur investissement; les solutions de numérisation incluant des opérations collaboratives et la réalité augmentée contribuent à améliorer la productivité des usines et des entreprises, à réduire les coûts d'entretien et d'énergie. Notre portefeuille d'ingénierie, de gestion de projet, de services et de solutions couvre un large éventail d'industries - mines, pâtes et papiers, métaux, aluminium et ciment, centres de données et aliments et boissons.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

HR Operations Team Lead

__

Your role and responsibilities
In this role you will be a core member of the HR Operational Services Team based in Baden. You will be contributing in delivering effective and efficient HR Services to the HR community, line managers and employees within ABB Switzerland and the Group's headquarters. You will be part of a motivated and dedicated team of HR Services and Payroll Specialists and support the Employee Lifecycle Team (ELC) in their daily business, projects and process improvements. This is a fixed-term job opportunity until end of May 2027.

The work model for the role is hybrid.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Provide first-level HR support for employees, line managers, and the HR community

  • Process ELC Switzerland requests and manage immigration/work permit procedures

  • Serve as specialist in complex HR cases/projects across countries

  • Actively contribute to end-to-end process improvements through feedback, experience, and initiatives


• Qualifications for the role

  • You hold a commercial degree with additional education in HR (e.g., Swiss federal vocational certificate in HR)

  • You bring at least 2 years professional experience in a similar role within HR Operations or Payroll and possess good knowledge of Swiss employment law and work permits

  • You are customer-oriented, reliable, and accurate in your work

jobs.title: Direct Current Datacenter System Architect
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Program Manager Solid State Transformer

__

Your role and responsibilities
We are looking for a Power Systems Architect to join our Direct Current Data Center Incubator, playing a critical role in driving the transformational shift toward next-generation Direct current data center architectures. Working closely with strategic customers - especially hyperscalers - you will help shape the future of data center architectures by translating complex customer challenges into innovative, optimized electrical solutions.

In this highly visible role, you will act as a trusted technical advisor across the full project lifecycle, combining deep technical expertise with strong consultative skills. You will influence market opportunities, support customer adoption, reduce churn, and enable flawless execution of pioneering Direct Current data center projects.

The work model for the role is: hybrid (#LI hybrid)

This position reports solid line to the Solid State Transformer Program Manager and dotted line to the Direct Current Datacenter Incubator Manager.

Key • Responsibilities

  • In collaboration with ABB data center segment and account managers partners closely with key customers - particularly hyperscalers - to support their transition from conventional AC data centers to advanced Direct Current data center architectures.

  • Design and architect end-to-end electrical power system solutions for data centers, delivering competitive, scalable, and future-ready system architectures.

  • Design protection and control— Designing Direct Current ‑specific protection schemes and overall control schemes for the future architecture including sequence of operation, managing the load and active monitoring.

  • Manage customer and market requirements and align the priorities for the product development teams.

  • Collaborate with internal engineering and product teams to identify technology gaps and influence product roadmap evolution.

  • Lead and support pilot projects, ensuring successful early-stage execution and delivery of novel Direct Current data center solutions.

  • Act as a technical authority and customer advocate throughout the sales, design, and delivery phases.

  • Contribute to technical thought leadership in emerging Direct Current power architectures and industry trends.

• Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline.

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in power system design, consulting, or solution architecture.

  • Strong background in data center power systems, or exposure to Direct Current power solu-tions (experience in adjacent industries such as marine or industrial Direct Current systems is highly valued).

  • Demonstrated track record of delivering complex, high-impact technical solutions.

  • Knowledge in electrical power systems, including switchgear, transformers, protection, control systems.

  • Ability to operate effectively in evolving technical environments.

  • Willingness to travel internationally, particularly to the United States.

  • Strong Cross-cultural awareness.

More about us

ABB's Distribution Solutions Division facilitates the efficient and reliable distribution, protection and control of power by improving electric power quality while strengthening the resilience of the grid. The Division offers segment-specific products and solutions that largely serve utilities, industry and infrastructure segments, often providing the requisite medium-voltage link between high-voltage transmission systems and low-voltage users. With ABB Ability™ enabled connected solutions at its core, the offering includes medium-voltage air- and gas-insulated switchgear (1 to 66 kilovolts), indoor and outdoor circuit breakers, reclosers, fuses, contactors, relays, instrument transformers, sensors, motor control centers, as well as low-voltage switchgear for the ANSI standard markets.

This opportunity is open to candidates in multiple countries, with the final work location determined based on the selected candidate. As compensation may vary by location, we are committed to being transparent throughout the hiring process and will share details of the salary range, variable compensation and benefits package with candidates who progress to the first interview stage for a location in the European Union, covered by the EU Pay Transparency Directive.

The final offer will be tailored based on your role location, experience, skills and qualifications, internal market positioning and alignment with ABB internal standards.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

  • Strong Cross-cultural awareness.
