jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Quality Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities:

We are looking for a Product Quality Engineer with a strong background in power electronics and proven experience in the design and validation of Uninterruptible Power Supplies (UPS). The Product Quality Engineer plays a pivotal role in collaborating with the R&D department for product design and implementation.

The work model for the role is: hybrid

This role is contributing to the Critical Power, Smart Power division in Quartino, Switzerland.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Acting as a quality interface between Agile Teams (R&D & Product Management), Operations, and Suppliers to ensure product robustness before the release (G5).

  • Furthermore you will be analyzing test data, quality KPIs, and field return issues and providing critical feedback during the definition of product requirements, influencing design for quality and reliability.

  • Managing quality product validation, according to ABB PCP (Product Creation Process) or equivalent methodologies (e.g., APQP), including test planning, design, and execution.

  • Actively supporting the Design FMEA, Process FMEA, and PPAP activities in cross-functional teams. Additionally, you will contribute to improving Design for Manufacturing (DFM) and Design for Testing (DFT), with a focus on PCBA production processes.


You will join a dynamic, talented and high-performing team, where you will be able to thrive.


• Qualifications for the role:

  • Master’s or Bachelor's Degree in Electronic Engineering.

  • Previous experience in product development as well as 5+ years of experience in the Power Electronics industry, preferably in the UPS sector.

  • Strong expertise in UPS architecture (single-phase and three-phase systems from 10 kW to 2 MW), including both hardware and software is preferred.

  • Hands-on experience with product validation plans, including definition, execution, and analysis of lab test results.

  • Solid knowledge of FMEA, PPAP, PCP/APQP quality tools and methodologies is desired.

  • Deep understanding of PCBA manufacturing processes, including the ability to influence design for testing and manufacturability.

  • Fluent or professional-level English (both spoken and written) with strong team spirit and ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment

More about us


ABB Smart Power is a global technology leader, with products and solutions that make power supplies smart, connected, and protected. Its intelligent products and solutions make power more competitive by improving the energy efficiency, productivity, and reliability of almost any operation. We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

À ABB, nous aidons les industries à fonctionner de façon plus rationnelle et plus propre. Vous aurez le pouvoir de diriger, de soutenir pour grandir, et fier de l'impact que nous créons ensemble. Rejoignez-nous et aidez-nous à exécuter ce qui dirige le monde.

Ce poste relève de:

Gestionnaire de la qualité

Votre rôle et vos responsabilités:

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un ingénieur de la qualité des produits avec une solide expérience en électronique de puissance et une expérience éprouvée dans la conception et la validation des alimentations non interruptibles (UPS). L'ingénieur de la qualité des produits joue un rôle central dans la collaboration avec le département de la R-D pour la conception et la mise en oeuvre des produits.

Le modèle de travail pour le rôle est : hybride

Ce rôle contribue à la division Puissance critique, Puissance intelligente à Quartino, Suisse.

Vous serez principalement responsable de :

  • En agissant comme interface de qualité entre les équipes agiles (gestion de la R-D et des produits), les opérations et les fournisseurs pour assurer la robustesse du produit avant la publication (G5).

  • De plus, vous analyserez les données d'essai, les ICR de qualité et les questions de retour sur le terrain et fournirez une rétroaction critique pendant la définition des exigences du produit, influençant la conception de la qualité et de la fiabilité.

  • Gestion de la validation du produit de qualité, selon le processus de création de produits ABB (processus de création de produits) ou des méthodologies équivalentes (p. ex., PAQA), y compris la planification, la conception et l'exécution des essais.

  • Soutenir activement les activités de conception FMEA, de processus FMEA et de PPAP dans les équipes interfonctionnelles. De plus, vous contribuerez à améliorer la conception pour la fabrication (DFM) et la conception pour les essais (DFT), en mettant l'accent sur les processus de production des BPCA.


Vous rejoindrez une équipe dynamique, talentueuse et performante, où vous pourrez prospérer.


• Qualifications pour le rôle :

  • Maîtrise ou baccalauréat en génie électronique.

  • Expérience antérieure dans le développement de produits ainsi que 5+ ans d'expérience dans l'industrie de l'électronique électrique, de préférence dans le secteur de l'UPS.

  • Expérience solide en architecture de l'UPS (systèmes monophasés et triphasés de 10 kW à 2 MW), y compris le matériel et les logiciels est préféré.

  • Expérience pratique des plans de validation des produits, y compris la définition, l'exécution et l'analyse des résultats des essais en laboratoire.

  • Une connaissance approfondie des méthodes et des outils de qualité du FMEA, du PPAP, du PCP/APQP est souhaitée.

  • Une compréhension approfondie des processus de fabrication de PCPA, y compris la capacité d'influencer la conception pour les essais et la fabrication.

  • En anglais souple ou professionnel (à la fois parlé et écrit) avec un esprit d'équipe solide et la capacité de travailler sous pression dans un environnement à rythme rapide

Plus sur nous


ABB Smart Power est un chef de file mondial de la technologie, avec des produits et des solutions qui rendent les approvisionnements électriques intelligents, connectés et protégés. Ses produits et solutions intelligents rendent la puissance plus compétitive en améliorant l'efficacité énergétique, la productivité et la fiabilité de presque toutes les opérations. Nous apprécions les gens de différents horizons. Ça pourrait être votre histoire ? Faites une demande aujourd'hui ou visitez www.abb.com pour en savoir plus sur nous et découvrez l'impact de nos solutions dans le monde entier.

Le processus de recrutement est soutenu par Talent Partner Gema de Vicente.

#ABBCareers

#RunwithABB

#Runwhatrunstheworld

Construire un avenir plus propre et plus intelligent prend toutes sortes d'esprits : les curieux, les courageux et les créatifs. C'est pourquoi nous accueillons des gens de tous les horizons et de toutes les expériences.

Prêt à faire un impact?

Appliquer aujourd'hui ou visiter https://www.abb.com pour en savoir plus sur l'impact de nos solutions à travers le monde.

jobs.title: R&D Senior Motor Designer (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

R&D Team Lead

__

Your Role & • Responsibilities

We are looking for an innovative and experienced R&D Senior Motor Designer (f/m/d) to play a key role in the development of next-generation motor concepts in the field of linear motor systems. In this role, you will combine deep technical expertise with a passion for innovation and a strong focus on industrialization and series readiness. Working in cross-functional international teams, you will make a significant contribution to our technological leadership and competitiveness.


In this role, you’ll help run what runs the world, by taking on meaningful work that drives real impact.

The work model for the role is: onsite with 10 home office days a month


  • Drive innovation from concept to series production
    Independently design and develop innovative linear motor concepts and validate your solutions using state-of-the-art FEM/CFD simulations and digital twin methodologies.
  • Balance technical performance and cost efficiency
    Apply design-to-cost principles to optimize both product quality and efficiency, while ensuring robust and reliable solutions through FMEA and DVP methods.
  • Turn ideas into manufacturable solutions
    Collaborate closely with procurement, suppliers, and manufacturing to ensure that new materials and concepts can be implemented efficiently and are suitable for industrial production (DFM/DFA).
  • Work across disciplines and functions
    Act as a key technical contributor, partnering closely with experts in power electronics, firmware, and software within globally distributed cross-functional teams.

Our team dynamics

Our teams support each other, collaborate, and never stop learning. Everyone brings something unique, and together we push ideas forward to solve real problems. Being part of our team means your work matters - because the progress we make here creates real impact out there.

What it takes to Run what runs the world

  • Degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field from a university or university of applied sciences
  • Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in the design, development, and validation of motors or electromagnetic components
  • Good expertise in FEM/CFD simulation, ideally with ANSYS Maxwell, Motor-CAD, or COMSOL
  • Solid know-how in winding technology, magnet design, tolerance management, and design for manufacturing/assembly (DFM/DFA)
  • Practical experience with quality methods such as FMEA and DVP, as well as industrial product development processes
  • Good working knowledge of CAD systems such as CATIA, Creo, or SolidWorks, as well as PLM platforms and relevant IEC/ISO standards
  • Very good German and English skills
  • A collaborative mindset, eagerness to learn, and a positive attitude

• We offer a full range of benefits to help you thrive at work and beyond:

  • Work-Life Balance – Flexible working models, including flextime and hybrid options, to support your personal and professional life.
  • Health & Well-being – Access to various health measures, a Global Employee Assistance Program, and a gender-neutral parental leave policy.
  • Financial Perks – Participation in the Global Employee Shareholder Acquisition Program (ESAP) and meal allowances.
  • Career Growth – Extensive training opportunities and structured development programs to help you advance.
  • Inclusive Culture – An international work environment that encourages collaboration and innovation.

Austria: The minimum compensation, in accordance with the electrical and electronics industry collective agreement, is € 4.472,11 - 4.905,47 monthly for a full-time position as of May 2026. But we would be pleased to speak in person about your compensation package in relation to your qualifications and experience!

More about us: Machine Automation, ABB
ABB’s Machine Automation division delivers automation solutions and services for machine and factory applications across industries such as consumer-packaged goods, printing, life sciences, plastics, energy and maritime. With its B&R’s product portfolio, the division delivers integrated control and software, motion control, mechatronics, and machine automation technologies designed to simplify processes and optimize factory operations.

Join us. Be part of the team where progress happens, industries transform, and your work shapes the world.

Run What Runs the World.

#ABBcareers #LI-Hybrid #RunwithABB #Runwhatrunstheworld

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

  • Gute Arbeitskenntnisse von CAD-Systemen wie CATIA, Creo oder SolidWorks sowie PLM-Plattformen und relevanten IEC/ISO-Standards

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Marketing & Sales Leader - ELSB/ELSP

__

As Sales Manager - Panel Builders, you will lead one of ABB Electrification's key sales channels in Switzerland. Combining strategic leadership with a strong customer focus, you will drive profitable growth, strengthen long-term customer relationships, and lead a high-performing sales team. Working closely with colleagues across the business, you will play an important role in shaping our commercial success while helping customers accelerate the transition to a more sustainable and electrified future.

The working model is: LI-Hybrid

Your main responsibilities will be:

  • Lead, coach, and develop the local Panel Builders sales team, fostering a high-performance, customer-centric culture and ensuring strong market coverage across all regions of Switzerland.

  • Drive profitable growth by identifying new business opportunities and implementing effective sales, market segmentation, and pricing strategies aligned with ABB’s business objectives.

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers and partners, ensuring an excellent customer experience throughout the entire sales process.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, product marketing, operations, and other stakeholders to support business success, while coordinating sales information flow, providing accurate forecasts and market insights, and managing commercial and contractual risks.

What we're looking for:

  • Bachelor's degree or similar in a technical field (preferably Electrical Engineering) with minimum 3 years of successful sales leadership background with a proven track record in the Swiss market.

  • Demonstrated people leadership experience and solid cross-functional collaboration and teamwork skills, with the ability to build effective relationships across functions and organizational levels.

  • Good technical knowledge of energy distribution and low-voltage switchgear or similar technical field. Furthermore, ability and interest to sell and promote digital solutions.

  • Sound understanding of contract negotiations, risk management, and commercial and legal terms.

  • Exceptional communication and negotiation skills, a customer-focused mindset, and a professional, proactive "can-do" attitude.

  • Fluent in German, with a good command of French and English.

More about us:

Electrification offers technologies across the entire electrification value chain—from the substation to the point of consumption. In doing so, it contributes to a secure and reliable power supply. The portfolio includes digital and connected innovations that improve the reliability and efficiency of low- and medium-voltage electrical installations. These include electric vehicle charging infrastructure, modular substations, distribution automation solutions, switchgear, sensor technology and control systems, as well as KNX systems for the automation and networking of building infrastructure.

This recruitment process is led by Reto Korstick, Talent Acquisition Partner, ABB Switzerland.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

  • Bachelor-Abschluss oder ähnliches in einem technischen Bereich (vorzugsweise Elektrotechnik) mit mindestens 3 Jahren erfolgreicher Vertriebsführung mit nachgewiesener Erfolgsbilanz auf dem Schweizer Markt.

  • Demonstrierte Führungserfahrung und solide funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit und Teamfähigkeit mit der Fähigkeit, effektive Beziehungen über Funktionen und Organisationsebenen hinweg aufzubauen.

Il s'agit notamment de l'infrastructure de recharge des véhicules électriques, des sous-stations modulaires, des solutions d'automatisation de la distribution, des systèmes de commutation, de la technologie des capteurs et des systèmes de commande, ainsi que des systèmes KNX pour l'automatisation et la mise en réseau des infrastructures de construction.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Team Manager – Industrial Software Research

__

Your role and responsibilities

As a research scientist in Software Systems Engineering, you will be working on the future architecture and design of ABB’s software-based products, with a special focus on the digitalization of industrial systems. We are looking for a team member with a proven research track record and the eagerness to transfer and apply world class academic research into an industrial environment. You will work within the highly motivated, international team of scientists at ABB Research. • We offer an open and innovative international work environment with many diverse opportunities to grow your career.

The work model for the role is: #LI-hybrid


You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Contribute to and/or lead research projects that turn state-of-the-art research results into effective software solutions for ABB.

  • Create prototypes of innovative concepts with real business impact

  • Evaluate new technologies and assess their impact on ABB products and roadmaps.

  • Disseminate your results in scientific publications, patent applications, and technical reports.

  • Build a network in the company and actively disseminate your knowledge and expertise.


• Qualifications for the role

  • PhD in computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering or in a related field

  • Experience in software engineering and system design

  • Theoretical and practical knowledge in one or multiple of the following topics: software engineering, distributed systems, computer networking, embedded systems, machine learning, cyber security

  • Hands-on experience in programming languages (e.g., C/C++, Python, Rust)

  • Proven publication track record at top scientific conferences and journals

  • Excellent communication skills and team player attitude

  • Solid experience of getting ideas from concepts to prototypes



Benefits

We also offer our employees the following benefits:

  • Flexible Work Practices

  • Employee Share Acquisition Plan

  • Canteen

More about us


At the ABB Research Center located in Baden-Dättwil in the proximity of Zurich, we work on cutting-edge technologies that shape the future of our products. The Industrial Software Systems research team explores topics like machine learning, cybersecurity, computer networking, distributed systems, and real-time systems. Our solutions are used to support the development of next-generation digital products and services of ABB.

We look forward to receiving your application (documents submitted in English are appreciated). If you want to discover more about ABB, take another look at our website www.abb.com.

This recruitment process is managed by Pedro Labian, Talent Acquisition Partner at ABB Switzerland.

What's in it for you:

We empower you to take initiative, explore new possibilities, and lead with confidence. You’ll grow through meaningful work, continuous learning, and support that’s tailored to your goals. Every idea you share and every action you take contributes to something bigger.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Team Manager – Industrial Software Research

__

Your role and responsibilities

As a research scientist in Software Systems Engineering, you will be working on the future architecture and design of ABB’s software-based products, with a special focus on the digitalization of industrial systems. We are looking for a team member with a proven research track record and the eagerness to transfer and apply world class academic research into an industrial environment. You will work within the highly motivated, international team of scientists at ABB Research. • We offer an open and innovative international work environment with many diverse opportunities to grow your career.

The work model for the role is: #LI-hybrid


You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Contribute to and/or lead research projects that turn state-of-the-art research results into effective software solutions for ABB.

  • Create prototypes of innovative concepts with real business impact

  • Evaluate new technologies and assess their impact on ABB products and roadmaps.

  • Disseminate your results in scientific publications, patent applications, and technical reports.

  • Build a network in the company and actively disseminate your knowledge and expertise.


• Qualifications for the role

  • PhD in computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering or in a related field

  • Experience in software engineering and system design

  • Theoretical and practical knowledge in one or multiple of the following topics: software engineering, distributed systems, computer networking, embedded systems, machine learning, cyber security

  • Hands-on experience in programming languages (e.g., C/C++, Python, Rust)

  • Proven publication track record at top scientific conferences and journals

  • Excellent communication skills and team player attitude

  • Solid experience of getting ideas from concepts to prototypes



Benefits

We also offer our employees the following benefits:

  • Flexible Work Practices

  • Employee Share Acquisition Plan

  • Canteen

More about us


At the ABB Research Center located in Baden-Dättwil in the proximity of Zurich, we work on cutting-edge technologies that shape the future of our products. The Industrial Software Systems research team explores topics like machine learning, cybersecurity, computer networking, distributed systems, and real-time systems. Our solutions are used to support the development of next-generation digital products and services of ABB.

We look forward to receiving your application (documents submitted in English are appreciated). If you want to discover more about ABB, take another look at our website www.abb.com.

This recruitment process is managed by Pedro Labian, Talent Acquisition Partner at ABB Switzerland.

What's in it for you:

We empower you to take initiative, explore new possibilities, and lead with confidence. You’ll grow through meaningful work, continuous learning, and support that’s tailored to your goals. Every idea you share and every action you take contributes to something bigger.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Research Team Manager - Power Device Physics

__


Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to contribute to ABB’s success with technology, software, product, and system development. Each day, you will identify and implement innovative solutions to relevant problems. You will also showcase your expertise by providing ideas and by being able to work both independently and as a part of a Research & Development (R&D) team.

The work model for the role is hybrid.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Conducting applied research in the area of power device physics with focus on dielectric insulation, breakdown phenomena, and other multi-physics topics

  • Contributing to and leading research projects towards sustainable solutions for the upcoming energy transformation, integration of renewable energies and energy storage systems

  • Applying commercial and in-house developed advanced simulation tools

  • Planning, setting up, and executing scientific experiments

  • Driving research activities, generating intellectual property, and writing scientific publications

  • Closely cooperating with scientists and engineers within the team, driving collaborations within the research center, with universities, and global ABB divisions

In this role, as a member of the Power Device Physics team, within Energy Technologies department, you work on the broad portfolio of ABB devices and systems from longer-term fundamental research up to time-critical questions in products. You provide novel and innovative solutions in the field of dielectric insulation in gases and solids with overlap to other multi-physical topics. Translating your findings from basic research on physical phenomena to prototypes demonstrating the technologies, you contribute to evolving applications in such fields as protection systems for sustainable energy generation and distribution. To achieve this, you utilize state-of-the-art simulations, perform scientific experiments, and apply the results to technology development and expert support of ABBs business divisions.


Reporting to the research team manager, you will engage with cross-functional teams inside and outside the company, contribute to the definition of the team research roadmap, and to the management of the research projects.


• Qualifications for the role

  • PhD in physics or electrical engineering, background in dielectric is a plus (please submit a list of publications if available).

  • Hands-on experience in a scientific or industrial laboratory, a willingness to work independently and take initiatives in designing, building, and testing prototypes

  • Experience in simulations, e.g., COMSOL

  • A collaborative, solution-focused approach with good ability to build and maintain work relationships

  • Strong communication and presentation skills in English (both written and spoken)

​More about us

The Power Device Physics Team at the ABB research center in Switzerland conducts interdisciplinary research focusing on multi-physical phenomena related to the broad portfolio of ABB's devices and systems, including switchgear and power electronics. The team consists of enthusiastic scientists and engineers whose activities span from deepening the knowledge of physical phenomena such as dielectric breakdowns in gases/solids/vacuum, or thermal management with novel cooling concepts, to solving questions directly related to ABB's product portfolio. Our expertise and solutions are used to enable and support the development of next-generation products. This unique opportunity allows you to carry out research in an evolving field and to contribute with your expertise to ABB’s success by reinforcing our team. If you are passionate about science and technology and want to work in an inspiring environment where your skills and ideas become part of solutions for a sustainable future, then apply now.


This recruitment process is managed by Pedro Labian, Talent Acquisition Partner at ABB Switzerland.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei ABB helfen wir Industrien, schlanker und sauberer zu laufen - und jeder Mensch hier macht das möglich. Sie werden in der Lage sein zu führen, unterstützt zu wachsen und stolz auf die Wirkung, die wir gemeinsam schaffen. Begleiten Sie uns und helfen Sie mit, was die Welt regiert.

Diese Position berichtet an:

Service Engineering Manager - GMD

Ihre Rolle und Verantwortlichkeiten

< In dieser Funktion stellen Sie die effektive Bereitstellung des Serviceportfolios gemäß den Standardprozessen und Sicherheitsrichtlinien von ABB sicher und gewährleisten die Kundenzufriedenheit. Jeden Tag bieten Sie technische Unterstützung, agieren als Spezialist und lösen Probleme in Ihrem Fachgebiet. Sie werden auch Ihre Expertise nutzen, indem Sie proaktiv mit Kunden und ABB Service Sales- und Lifecycle-Management-Teams kommunizieren, um die Kundenbedürfnisse zu verstehen und Geschäftsmöglichkeiten für Servicewachstum zu nutzen. Die Rolle umfasst Aufgaben vor Ort bis zu 40% der Zeit.

Das Arbeitsmodell für die Rolle ist: LI-Hybrid

Diese Rolle trägt zum Business Line Mining & Materials in einer globalen Führungsrolle für das Ankerprodukt GMD (Gearless Mill Drive) bei. Zu den Hauptakteuren gehören Kunden, interne Service-Vertriebs- und Life-Cycle-Management-Teams und andere technische Disziplinen.

Sie sind hauptsächlich verantwortlich für:

  • Bereitstellung von technischem Support und Lösung von Problemen über Remote- oder On-Site-Service, einschließlich Installation und Inbetriebnahme, Wartung, Reparaturen, Fehlersuche, Back-Office-Engineering und -Beratung, Retrofit-Engineering usw.

  • Untersuchung der Kundenbedürfnisse durch professionelle Beratung. Darüber hinaus verwalten Kundenbeziehungen und pflegen regelmäßigen Kontakt mit wichtigen Kunden und als 24/7 Support-Linie für eine ganze Woche, ca. Alle zwei Monate, je nach Verfügbarkeit.

  • Proaktiv Produkt- und Qualitätsverbesserungen vorschlagen und innerhalb der ABB-Organisation kommunizieren.

  • Bereitstellung technischer Beratung zu Servicelösungen für Management und Kunden. Sie werden einem wirklich internationalen und dynamischen Team beitreten, in dem Sie gedeihen können.

• Qualifikationen für die Rolle

  • Ein Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Elektrotechnik oder einem verwandten Bereich.

  • Nachgewiesene Erfahrung als Elektroingenieur, Produktspezialist oder in einer ähnlichen technischen Rolle, vorzugsweise im Bereich der Leistungselektronik.

  • Ein kollaborativer, lösungsorientierter Ansatz mit effektiven Kommunikations- und Beziehungsaufbaufähigkeiten.

  • Exzellente Kommunikation und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten, die eine nahtlose Zusammenarbeit zwischen Abteilungen und Kunden ermöglichen.

  • Achtung auf Details, Gewährleistung von Produktkonformität, genauer technischer Dokumentation und Einhaltung von Qualitätsnormen.

  • Fluency in Englisch ist erforderlich. Kenntnisse in anderen Sprachen wie Spanisch sind ein Plus.

Mehr über uns

GREAT MINDS, GREAT MINES Von Mobiltelefonen, Elektrofahrzeugen, Batterien, Windparks ... praktisch jeder Aspekt des modernen Lebens hängt von den Erzen ab, die von der Erde abgebaut werden. Aber es muss eine Transformation geben. Die Nachfrage nach Mineralien hat deutlich zugenommen, was den nachhaltigen, sicheren und produktiven Bergbau wichtiger denn je macht. Die GMD von ABB ist das leistungsstärkste Mühlenantriebssystem auf dem Markt für halbautogene (SAG), Kugel- und autogene (AG) Mühlen. Dieses "Arbeitspferd" für Schleifvorgänge kombiniert ein robustes, servicefreundliches und zweckgerechtes Design, um den höchsten Durchsatz, die Zuverlässigkeit und die Verfügbarkeit für Ihre Verarbeitungsanlage zu bieten.

Der Aufbau einer saubereren, intelligenteren Zukunft erfordert alle Arten von Köpfen: das Neugierige, das Mutige und das Kreative. Deshalb begrüßen wir Menschen mit allen Hintergründen und Erfahrungen.

Ready to make a impact?

Bewerben Sie sich noch heute oder besuchen Sie https://www.abb.com, um mehr über die Auswirkungen unserer Lösungen auf der ganzen Welt zu erfahren.

À ABB, nous aidons les industries à fonctionner de façon plus rationnelle et plus propre. Vous aurez le pouvoir de diriger, de soutenir pour grandir, et fier de l'impact que nous créons ensemble. Rejoignez-nous et aidez à exécuter ce qui dirige le monde.

Ce poste relève de :

Gestionnaire du génie des services - GMD

Votre rôle et vos responsabilités

Dans ce rôle, vous assurerez la prestation efficace du portefeuille de services selon les processus standards et les lignes directrices de sécurité d'ABB, assurant ainsi la satisfaction des clients. Chaque jour, vous fournirez un soutien technique, agirez comme un spécialiste et résoudrez des problèmes dans votre domaine d'expertise. Vous tirerez également parti de votre expertise en communiquant de manière proactive avec les clients et les équipes de gestion des ventes et du cycle de vie d'ABB afin de comprendre les besoins des clients et de tirer parti des occasions d'affaires pour la croissance du service. Le rôle comprend des affectations sur place jusqu'à 40 % du temps.

Le modèle de travail pour le rôle est : LI-Hybrid

Ce rôle contribue au secteur d'activité Mines et matériaux dans un rôle de leadership mondial pour le produit d'ancrage GMD (Gearless Mill Drive). Les principaux intervenants comprennent les clients, les équipes de gestion des ventes de services internes et du cycle de vie et d'autres disciplines du génie.

Vous serez principalement responsable de :

  • Fournir un soutien technique et résoudre les problèmes par le biais d'un service à distance ou sur place, y compris l'installation et la mise en service, l'entretien, les réparations, les prises de vue, l'ingénierie et la consultation back-office, l'ingénierie de la modernisation, etc.

  • Enquêter sur les besoins des clients par le biais de conseils professionnels. En outre, gérer les relations avec les clients et maintenir un contact régulier avec les clients clés et agir comme ligne de soutien 24/7 pendant une semaine complète, environ. tous les deux mois, selon la disponibilité.

  • Proposer de façon proactive des améliorations du produit et de la qualité et les communiquer au sein de l'organisme ABB.

  • Fournir des conseils techniques sur les solutions de service à la direction et aux clients. Vous rejoindrez une équipe vraiment internationale et dynamique, où vous pourrez prospérer.

• Qualifications pour le rôle

  • Un baccalauréat ou une maîtrise en génie électrique ou dans tout domaine connexe.

  • Expérience éprouvée en tant qu'ingénieur en électricité, spécialiste du produit ou dans un rôle technique semblable, de préférence dans le secteur de l'électronique de puissance.

  • Une approche collaborative axée sur la solution, avec des compétences efficaces en matière de communication et d'établissement de relations.

  • Excellentes compétences en communication et en relations interpersonnelles, permettant une collaboration harmonieuse entre les ministères et avec les clients.

  • Attention aux détails, en veillant à la conformité du produit, à l'exactitude de la documentation technique et au respect de la norme de qualité.

  • La maîtrise d'autres langues comme l'espagnol est un plus.

En savoir plus sur nous

GRANDES MINDES, GRANDES MINES Des téléphones cellulaires, des véhicules électriques, des batteries, des parcs éoliens... presque tous les aspects de la vie moderne dépendent des minerais extraits de la terre. Mais il doit y avoir une transformation. La demande de minéraux a considérablement augmenté, rendant l'exploitation minière durable, sûre et productive plus cruciale que jamais. Le GMD d'ABB est le système d'entraînement le plus puissant du marché pour alimenter les usines semi-autogènes (SAG), à billes et autogènes (AG). Ce cheval de travail pour les opérations de broyage combine une conception robuste, conviviale et adaptée à l'usage pour fournir le débit, la fiabilité et la disponibilité le plus élevé pour votre usine de transformation.

Construire un avenir plus propre et plus intelligent prend toutes sortes d'esprits : les curieux, les courageux et les créatifs. C'est pourquoi nous accueillons des gens de tous les horizons et de toutes les expériences.

jobs.title: Research Department Manager - Industrial Solutions (80 - 100%) f/m/d
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

R&D Unit Lead

__

At ABB’s Research Center in Baden-Dättwil, Switzerland, we explore new technologies that support and drive the development of ABB’s next-generation products and solutions.


The Industrial Solutions department is organized into four research teams that collaborate closely with development teams across ABB’s various divisions. Our research activities cover a broad range of fields, including Power Electronics (converter topologies, control, EMC, and reliability), Industrial Software (cybersecurity, ML/AI, real-time embedded systems, and connected systems), as well as Sensing & Analytics (sensor technologies, perception, and electronics).


This is a unique opportunity for a leader who is passionate about combining people management with the strategic alignment of an R&D department, while also overseeing operational aspects such as work safety, R&D processes, and stakeholder management.

Your main responsibilities include

  • Lead and represent the department with 45 members: people management (recruitment, development), support of project portfolio management and research strategy, continuous improvement of processes and lab infrastructure

  • Support the Research Center Management Team as active member, including the coordination of global R&D activities

  • Guarantee professional, top quality definition and execution of R&D projects

  • Contribute to extend the technical and process knowledge to the organization with special focus on HSE topics

• Qualifications for the role

  • Experience in leading an R&D group or an R&D department

  • Communication and leadership skills

  • PhD in physics, electrical engineering, computer science, chemistry or a similar R&D track record

  • Knowledge of at least two of the core topics described above, combined with a willingness and ability to develop knowledge in other areas

  • Experience with the development process for industrial products

  • Track record in delivering market-oriented R&D results

  • Fluency in English and basic knowledge of German


More about us
• We offer an inspiring international environment, the opportunity to influence breakthrough technologies with real-world impact, and excellent prospects for professional and leadership development.

The hiring process for this role is managed by Pedro Labian Sanchez, Talent Acquisition Partner at ABB Switzerland.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Im ABB-Forschungszentrum in Baden-Dättwil, Schweiz, erforschen wir neue Technologien, die die Entwicklung der Produkte und Lösungen der nächsten Generation von ABB unterstützen und vorantreiben.

Im ABB-Forschungszentrum in Baden-Dättwil, Schweiz. Die Abteilung Industrial Solutions ist in vier Forschungsteams organisiert, die eng mit Entwicklungsteams in den verschiedenen Divisionen von ABB zusammenarbeiten. Unsere Forschungsaktivitäten decken eine breite Palette von Bereichen ab, darunter Power Electronics (Konvertertopologien, Steuerung, EMV und Zuverlässigkeit), Industrial Software (Cybersecurity, ML / AI, eingebettete Echtzeitsysteme und vernetzte Systeme) sowie Sensing & Analytics (Sensortechnologien, Wahrnehmung und Elektronik).


Dies ist eine einzigartige Gelegenheit für eine Führungskraft, die sich leidenschaftlich für die Kombination von Personalmanagement mit der strategischen Ausrichtung einer F&E-Abteilung einsetzt und gleichzeitig operative Aspekte wie Arbeitssicherheit, F&E-Prozesse und Stakeholder-Management betreut.

Ihre Hauptaufgaben umfassen

  • Lead und vertreten die Abteilung mit 45 Mitgliedern: Personalmanagement (Rekrutierung, Entwicklung), Unterstützung des Projektportfoliomanagements und der Forschungsstrategie, kontinuierliche Verbesserung von Prozessen und Laborinfrastruktur

  • Unterstützen Sie das Managementteam des Forschungszentrums als aktives Mitglied, einschließlich der Koordination globaler F&E-Aktivitäten

  • Garantie professionell, qualitativ hochwertige Definition und Durchführung von F&E-Projekten

  • Beitrag zur Erweiterung des technischen und prozessualen Wissens auf die Organisation mit besonderem Fokus auf HSE-Themen

• Qualifikationen für die Rolle

  • Erfahrung in der Leitung einer F&E-Gruppe oder einer F&E-Abteilung

  • Kommunikations- und Führungsqualitäten

  • PhD in Physik, Elektrotechnik, Informatik, Chemie oder einer ähnlichen F&E-Ergebnisbilanz

  • Kenntnisse in mindestens zwei der oben beschriebenen Kernthemen, kombiniert mit der Bereitschaft und Fähigkeit, Wissen in anderen Bereichen zu entwickeln

  • Erfahrung mit dem Entwicklungsprozess für Industrieprodukte

  • Track record in der Lieferung marktorientierter F&E-Ergebnisse

  • Fluency in English and basic knowledge of German

  • Mehr über uns
    • Wir bieten ein inspirierendes internationales Umfeld, die Möglichkeit, bahnbrechende Technologien mit realen Auswirkungen zu beeinflussen, und hervorragende Perspektiven für die berufliche und Führungsentwicklung.

    Der Einstellungsprozess für diese Rolle wird von Pedro Labian Sanchez, Talent Acquisition Partner bei ABB Schweiz, geleitet.

    Der Aufbau einer saubereren, intelligenteren Zukunft erfordert alle Arten von Köpfen: das Neugierige, das Mutige und das Kreative. Deshalb begrüßen wir Menschen mit allen Hintergründen und Erfahrungen.

R&D Unit Lead

Au Centre de recherche d'ABB à Baden-Dättwil, en Suisse, nous étudions de nouvelles technologies qui soutiennent et stimulent le développement de produits et de solutions de prochaine génération d'ABB.

  • Représenter le ministère avec 45 membres : gestion des ressources humaines (recrutement, perfectionnement), appui à la gestion du portefeuille de projets et à la stratégie de recherche, amélioration continue des processus et de l'infrastructure des laboratoires

  • Garantie professionnelle, définition et exécution de projets de R-D de qualité supérieure

  • Contribuer à étendre les connaissances techniques et de processus à l'organisation en mettant l'accent sur les sujets de l'ESH

  • Expérience dans la direction d'un groupe de R-D ou d'un département de R-D

  • Compétences en communication et en leadership

  • Connaissance d'au moins deux des principaux sujets décrits ci-dessus, combinée à la volonté et à la capacité de développer des connaissances dans d'autres domaines

  • Expérience avec le processus de développement des produits industriels

  • Track record dans la prestation de résultats de R-D axés sur le marché

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Regional Sales Manager Europe for Excitation & Hydropower

__

Job • Profile Summary

Implements the sales strategy and drives the respective sales process in Hydropower and industries in collaboration with the Local Division Sales Manager and the Business Line Sales Manager Europe. Generates sales opportunities and secures profitable sales for ABB’s Energy Industries Division and its Business Line Power Reliability in Switzerland. Builds long-term customer relationships and ensures immediate response to specific customer needs and issues.


Core • Responsibilities

  • Focuses on new greenfield projects, as well as on Installed Base (IB) and brownfield penetration and sells the entire solutions portfolio (across automation, excitation, protection, electrification, grid code compliance studies, and digital solutions) in collaboration with other ABB units.

  • Sells entire solutions portfolio to expand ABB’s footprint in Switzerland and acts as a marketer/salesperson of ABB’s products and solutions during marketing activities (campaigns, trade fairs, exhibitions, conferences, customer meetings).

  • Establishes long-term customer relationships by understanding their requirements and translates the needs of customer into relevant ABB offerings and solutions.

  • Understands the channel strategy and the establishment of related prices and prepares sales plan, reviews them, and proposes recovery plan(s) when needed.

• Qualifications for the role

  • Experience in business development, technical sales or bids and proposals, ideally within the power generation, automation, electrification, or industrial sectors.

  • Strong solution selling and value proposition creation abilities, cybersecurity and digital solutions acumen.

  • Strong understanding of project dynamics and Installed Base (IB) concepts and confidently promoting value‑adding solutions.

  • Skilled in identifying, developing, and securing sales opportunities based on customer needs and market trends.

  • Customer-focused mindset with strong communication and negotiation skills, building long‑term customer relationships and responding quickly and professionally to customer issues.

  • Willingness to travel as required (up to 50%).

  • Ability to fluently communicate in German and English; additional languages are an advantage (French).

Kurzprofil der Position

Setzt die Vertriebsstrategie um und steuert den entsprechenden Verkaufsprozess im Bereich Wasserkraft und Industrie in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem lokalen Divisionsvertriebsleiter sowie dem Business Line Sales Manager Europe. Generiert Verkaufschancen und erzielt profitable Verkaufsabschlüsse für die Division Energy Industries von ABB sowie deren Business Line Power Reliability in der Schweiz. Baut langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf und gewährleistet eine schnelle und professionelle Reaktion auf spezifische Kundenanforderungen und Anliegen.

Hauptaufgaben

  • Fokus auf neue Greenfield-Projekte sowie auf die Durchdringung der installierten Basis (Installed Base, IB) und von Brownfield-Projekten. Verkauf des gesamten Lösungsportfolios in Zusammenarbeit mit anderen ABB-Einheiten, darunter Automatisierungs-, Erregungs-, Schutz- und Elektrifizierungslösungen, Netzanschluss- und Grid-Code-Compliance-Studien sowie digitale Lösungen.

  • Vermarktung und Verkauf des gesamten Lösungsportfolios zur Erweiterung der ABB-Marktpräsenz in der Schweiz. Repräsentation von ABB-Produkten und -Lösungen bei Marketingaktivitäten wie Kampagnen, Messen, Ausstellungen, Konferenzen und Kundengesprächen.

  • Aufbau langfristiger Kundenbeziehungen durch das Verständnis der Kundenanforderungen und die Entwicklung passender ABB-Lösungen und Angebote.

  • Verständnis der Vertriebs- und Channel-Strategie sowie der entsprechenden Preisgestaltung. Erstellung und Überprüfung von Vertriebsplänen sowie Entwicklung von Gegenmaßnahmen und Aktionsplänen bei Bedarf.

Qualifikationen

  • Erfahrung in Business Development, technischem Vertrieb oder im Angebots- und Ausschreibungsmanagement, idealerweise in den Bereichen Energieerzeugung, Automatisierung, Elektrifizierung oder Industrie.

  • Ausgeprägte Fähigkeiten im Lösungsvertrieb und in der Entwicklung überzeugender Kundennutzenargumentationen sowie Kenntnisse im Bereich Cybersecurity und digitaler Lösungen.

  • Fundiertes Verständnis von Projektdynamiken und Installed-Base-Konzepten sowie die Fähigkeit, wertschöpfende Lösungen überzeugend zu positionieren.

  • Erfahrung in der Identifikation, Entwicklung und erfolgreichen Umsetzung von Vertriebschancen auf Basis von Kundenbedürfnissen und Markttrends.

  • Ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung sowie starke Kommunikations- und Verhandlungsfähigkeiten mit Fokus auf den Aufbau langfristiger Kundenbeziehungen und eine schnelle, professionelle Bearbeitung von Kundenanliegen.

  • Reisebereitschaft von bis zu 50 %.

  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse; weitere Sprachen, insbesondere Französisch, sind von Vorteil.

Résumé du poste

Met en œuvre la stratégie commerciale et pilote le processus de vente correspondant dans les secteurs de l’hydroélectricité et de l’industrie, en collaboration avec le Responsable commercial local de la division et le Business Line Sales Manager Europe. Génère des opportunités commerciales et assure des ventes rentables pour la division Energy Industries d’ABB et sa Business Line Power Reliability en Suisse. Développe des relations clients durables et garantit une réponse rapide aux besoins et problématiques spécifiques des clients.

Responsabilités principales

  • Se concentre sur les nouveaux projets Greenfield ainsi que sur le développement de la base installée (Installed Base, IB) et des projets Brownfield. Commercialise l’ensemble du portefeuille de solutions (automatisation, systèmes d’excitation, protection, électrification, études de conformité aux codes réseau et solutions numériques) en collaboration avec les autres unités d’ABB.

  • Vend l’ensemble du portefeuille de solutions afin de renforcer la présence d’ABB en Suisse et agit en tant qu’ambassadeur commercial des produits et solutions ABB lors d’activités marketing (campagnes, salons professionnels, expositions, conférences et rendez-vous clients).

  • Établit des relations clients à long terme en comprenant leurs exigences et en les traduisant en offres et solutions ABB pertinentes.

  • Comprend la stratégie de vente indirecte et la politique tarifaire associée. Prépare les plans de vente, les analyse et propose des plans d’actions correctifs lorsque cela est nécessaire.

• Qualifications requises

  • Expérience en développement commercial, vente technique ou gestion des offres et appels d’offres, idéalement dans les secteurs de la production d’énergie, de l’automatisation, de l’électrification ou de l’industrie.

  • Solides compétences en vente de solutions et en création de propositions de valeur, ainsi qu’une bonne compréhension des enjeux liés à la cybersécurité et aux solutions numériques.

  • Excellente compréhension des dynamiques de projet et des concepts liés à la base installée (IB), avec la capacité de promouvoir avec assurance des solutions à forte valeur ajoutée.

  • Aptitude à identifier, développer et concrétiser des opportunités commerciales sur la base des besoins des clients et des tendances du marché.

  • Forte orientation client, excellentes compétences en communication et en négociation, avec une capacité à construire des relations durables et à répondre rapidement et professionnellement aux demandes des clients.

  • Disponibilité pour des déplacements professionnels pouvant atteindre 50 % du temps.

  • Maîtrise courante de l’allemand et de l’anglais ; la connaissance d’autres langues, notamment le français, constitue un atout.

More about us

ABB’s Energy Industries Division is enabling safe, smart, and sustainable projects and operations for businesses across the oil, gas, chemicals, life sciences, power generation, and water sectors. Driving integrated solutions that automate, digitalize, and electrify operations across industries. The division strives to connect our people and technology capabilities, along with our robust global execution capacity and widespread service footprint to help customers adapt and succeed. With over 50 years of domain expertise, we continue to innovate and reshape traditional approaches across the energy sector with our technologies, that are designed to improve operational efficiency, reduce risk, decrease energy consumption and waste.

Our Benefits

  • Attractive compensation including bonus, 13th-month salary, and participation programs (ESAP).

  • Career development through targeted training and development opportunities.

  • REKA checks for leisure and travel.

  • Company holidays between Christmas and New Year.

  • Various discounts on sports equipment, electronics, and health & wellness offers.

  • Contribution toward gym membership.

The recruitment process is led by Talent Partner Gema de Vicente.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Chapter Lead

__

Contributes to ABB's success with technology, software, product, and/or system development. Identifies and implements innovative solutions to relevant problems. Provides ideas and can work both independently and as a part of a Research & Development (R&D) team.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to contribute to ABB’s success with technology, software, products, and system development. Each day, you will identify and implement innovative solutions to relevant problems. You will also showcase your expertise by providing ideas and by being able to work both independently and as a part of a Research & Development (R&D) team.

The work model for the role is: hybrid #LI-hybrid

Location: Quartino Switzerland

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Firmware Development: Design, develop, and implement firmware for Power Electronic Converters and communication modules, ensuring robust functionality and cybersecurity
  • Software Quality Assurance: Conduct unit, integration, and system testing to validate software performance and reliability
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with system architects and hardware/software engineers to translate system requirements into detailed firmware specifications
  • Innovation and Knowledge Sharing: Contribute to intellectual property creation and collaborate with global engineering teams to drive continuous improvement and share expertise

• Qualifications for the Role:

  • M.Sc. or B.Sc. degree in Information or Electrical, Power Electronic, Electronic Engineering, Embedded Systems, or comparable field
  • You have at least 3 years of experience in designing control firmware based on microcontrollers / DSPs for Power Electronic Products such as UPS, BESS, Renewable Energy systems
  • You are highly skilled in C/C++/Python and Firmware Development.
  • You have solid knowledge in structured development processes, ranging from requirement analysis, design, and implementation to test and documentation.
  • Experience with development infrastructure, including Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, version control systems (Git), lifecycle management, build systems, unit testing, debug probes, oscilloscopes, and similar tools
  • Exposure to Cyber Security concepts and knowledge of main industrial communication protocols (Modbus, CAN, EtherCAT) are a plus
  • You are passionate about teamwork and innovation.
  • You are at ease communicating in English and Italian

More about us

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

Join us. Be part of the team where progress happens, industries transform, and your work shapes the world.


Run What Runs the World.

#ABBCareers #RunwithABB

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Chapter Lead

__

As an R&D Senior Engineer, you will leverage your technical expertise to validate and customize OEM single-phase and three-phase low-voltage Uninterruptible Power Supplies (UPS), ensuring they meet the requirements of mission-critical power protection applications and market specifications.

Reporting to R&D Hardware Chapter Lead, based in Quartino Switzerland, you will contribute significantly to initiatives related to ABB’s Uninterruptable Power Supplies (UPS) products

The work model for the role is: hybrid #LI-hybrid

Location: Quartino Switzerland

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Lead technical validation and customization of OEM 1ph and 3ph low voltage Uninterruptable Power Supplies (UPS), as well as batteries and accessories.
  • Manage test partners (UL, Intertek, Dekra, Eurofins, etc.) to scope and plan test programs to demonstrate compliance with applicable IEC or UL standards.
  • Manage the technical specifications of assigned products and support the Product Manager in developing the business case for product development.
  • Drive root cause analysis and corrective actions related to issues found during qualification testing, as well as issues identified at customer sites.
  • Maintain awareness of state-of-the-art technologies and collaborate with the research center in Switzerland and other ABB stakeholders to identify potential new UPS technologies.

• Qualifications for the Role:

  • Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, along with more than five years of professional experience in electrical engineering.
  • Must have experience working with power electronic systems
  • Experience in the use of various measuring equipment in a laboratory environment.
  • Knowledge of product regulations and standards, including IEC and UL.
  • Experience working with external laboratories and certification bodies.
  • Knowledge of ECNs (Engineering Change Notifications), BOMs (Bills of Materials), and documentation systems.
  • Experience with failure investigations and Root Cause Analysis (RCA).
  • Knowledge of and experience with Agile methodology is an advantage.
  • Fluent in English, both spoken and written.

More about us

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Critical Power unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

can thrive.

This position reports to:

Production Engineering Manager

__

In this role, you will have the opportunity to optimize the Production organization’s assembly methods, processes, and equipment to minimize labor hours in accordance with business strategies related to quality, efficiency, costs, and safety. Each day, you will ensure appropriate production methods, cycle time, equipment performance, work instruction, and materials/components in support of production targets. The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

This role is contributing to Power Protection

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Identifying and recommending improvement opportunities and implements improvement projects, ensuring adherence to timeframe, quality, and cost requirements.
  • Providing the necessary work instruction
  • Ensure product maintenance through the introduction of the engineering change notice
  • Approving process designs developed internally or externally, performing final project testing, evaluating and implementing new process technologies, and supporting production during process/equipment start-up through action plans, technical guidance, and training of maintenance and production teams.

• Qualifications for the role:

  • Degree in Electric/Mechanic Engineering.
  • 5+ years of experience in operation and production line activities.
  • Knowledge of Engineering & Manufacturing Processes.
  • Proficiency in MS Office; preferred are: 2D/3D CAD systems, SAP and Windchill.
  • Proficiency in English and mandatory proficiency in Italian, both spoken and written.
  • Positive spirit, self-motivation, team working, efficiency and problem-solving orientation; focus on delivering results by taking responsibility for assigned tasks and projects

Benefits:

  • Attractive compensation including bonus, 13th-month salary, and participation programs (ESAP).
  • Career development through targeted training and development opportunities.
  • REKA checks for leisure and travel.
  • Company holidays between Christmas and New Year.
  • Various discounts on sports equipment, electronics, and health & wellness offers.

More about us:

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

jobs.title: (Senior) Scientist for EMC in Power Electronics
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Research Team Manager - Power Electronic Systems

__

Your role and responsibilities

Our team's mission is to drive innovation at the intersection of power electronic converters and electromagnetics, translating cutting-edge research into next-generation ABB products. We focus on electromagnetic modeling of power converter systems and components, conducted and radiat-ed emissions mitigation, passive and active filtering strategies, and shielding. By joining us, you will shape the future of energy systems — generating pioneering ideas at the frontier of academic research and industrial innovation, while developing transformative technologies that advance ABB's product portfolio.


Are you passionate about enabling a sustainable future through electromagnetics research in pow-er converter systems? We want to hear from you! A dynamic, international team is excited to wel-come you as our newest member. Together, we will push boundaries and make a lasting impact on the energy transition.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid


You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Pioneer innovative concepts for ensuring electromagnetic compatibility and interference compliance in high-power converters

  • Develop EMC models to predict and analyze electromagnetic compatibility and optimize electromagnetic design of circuits and systems

  • EMC measurements of conducted and radiated emissions of converters and HF characterization of components

  • Patent innovative solutions and demonstrate technology leadership through e.g., high-impact publications

  • Collaborate closely with ABB research centers, business units, and universities to transition research into real-world applications


• Qualifications for the role

  • PhD in electrical engineering, physics or related discipline with specialization in power electronics or electromagnetics

  • Proven research excellence demonstrated through high-impact publications and patents

  • Deep technical expertise in:

    • EMC/EMI theory and solid theoretical background in electromagnetic modelling and field simulations

    • Power electronic converter topologies, filters, magnetics, and semiconductor switching devices

    • Simulation tools such as CST, COMSOL, ANSYS, SPICE circuit simulator (LTSpice, SIMetrix), Simulink

  • Hands-on laboratory skills in HF-electromagnetic measurements (conducted and/or radiated emissions), with a proactive, self-driven approach to designing, building, and testing EMC/EMI-compliant power converters. Versatile skill set with the ability to bridge theory and practice across multiple technical domains.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced industrial research environment and deliver results

  • Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal


Benefits

We also offer our employees the following benefits:

  • Canteen

  • Flexible work practices

  • Childcare


More about us

At the ABB Research Center in Baden-Dättwil in the proximity of Zurich, we work on exciting technologies that shape the future of our products. Our international research teams focus on Power Electronics, Energy Storage, Intelligent Systems, and Switching.

We look forward to receiving your application.



Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Research Team Manager - Power Electronic Systems

__

Your role and responsibilities

Our team's mission is to drive innovation at the intersection of power electronic converters and electromagnetics, translating cutting-edge research into next-generation ABB products. We focus on electromagnetic modeling of power converter systems and components, conducted and radiat-ed emissions mitigation, passive and active filtering strategies, and shielding. By joining us, you will shape the future of energy systems — generating pioneering ideas at the frontier of academic research and industrial innovation, while developing transformative technologies that advance ABB's product portfolio.


Are you passionate about enabling a sustainable future through electromagnetics research in pow-er converter systems? We want to hear from you! A dynamic, international team is excited to wel-come you as our newest member. Together, we will push boundaries and make a lasting impact on the energy transition.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid


You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Pioneer innovative concepts for ensuring electromagnetic compatibility and interference compliance in high-power converters

  • Develop EMC models to predict and analyze electromagnetic compatibility and optimize electromagnetic design of circuits and systems

  • EMC measurements of conducted and radiated emissions of converters and HF characterization of components

  • Patent innovative solutions and demonstrate technology leadership through e.g., high-impact publications

  • Collaborate closely with ABB research centers, business units, and universities to transition research into real-world applications


• Qualifications for the role

  • PhD in electrical engineering, physics or related discipline with specialization in power electronics or electromagnetics

  • Proven research excellence demonstrated through high-impact publications and patents

  • Deep technical expertise in:

    • EMC/EMI theory and solid theoretical background in electromagnetic modelling and field simulations

    • Power electronic converter topologies, filters, magnetics, and semiconductor switching devices

    • Simulation tools such as CST, COMSOL, ANSYS, SPICE circuit simulator (LTSpice, SIMetrix), Simulink

  • Hands-on laboratory skills in HF-electromagnetic measurements (conducted and/or radiated emissions), with a proactive, self-driven approach to designing, building, and testing EMC/EMI-compliant power converters. Versatile skill set with the ability to bridge theory and practice across multiple technical domains.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced industrial research environment and deliver results

  • Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal


Benefits

We also offer our employees the following benefits:

  • Canteen

  • Flexible work practices

  • Childcare


More about us

At the ABB Research Center in Baden-Dättwil in the proximity of Zurich, we work on exciting technologies that shape the future of our products. Our international research teams focus on Power Electronics, Energy Storage, Intelligent Systems, and Switching.

We look forward to receiving your application.



Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

At ABB helfen wir Industrien, schlanker und sauberer zu laufen - und jeder Mensch hier macht das möglich. Sie werden in der Lage sein zu führen, unterstützt zu wachsen und stolz auf die Wirkung, die wir gemeinsam schaffen. Begleiten Sie uns und helfen Sie mit, was die Welt regiert.

Diese Position berichtet an:

Research Team Manager - Power Electronic Systems

Ihre Rolle und Verantwortlichkeiten

Die Mission unseres Teams ist es, Innovationen an der Schnittstelle von Leistungselektronikwandlern und Elektromagnetik voranzutreiben und Spitzenforschung in ABB-Produkte der nächsten Generation zu übersetzen. Wir konzentrieren uns auf elektromagnetische Modellierung von Stromrichtersystemen und -komponenten, leitungsgeführte und abgestrahlte Emissionsminderung, passive und aktive Filterstrategien und Abschirmung. Indem Sie sich uns anschließen, gestalten Sie die Zukunft der Energiesysteme - und erzeugen bahnbrechende Ideen an der Grenze der akademischen Forschung und der industriellen Innovation, während Sie transformative Technologien entwickeln, die das Produktportfolio von ABB voranbringen.


Sind Sie leidenschaftlich daran interessiert, eine nachhaltige Zukunft durch elektromagnetische Forschung in Pulverwandlersystemen zu ermöglichen? Wir wollen von Ihnen hören! Ein dynamisches, internationales Team freut sich, Sie als unser neuestes Mitglied begrüßen zu dürfen. Gemeinsam werden wir Grenzen überschreiten und die Energiewende nachhaltig vorantreiben.

Das Arbeitsmodell für die Rolle lautet: #LI-Hybrid


Sie sind hauptsächlich verantwortlich für:

  • Pioneer innovative Konzepte zur Gewährleistung der elektromagnetischen Kompatibilität und Interferenz-Compliance in Hochleistungswandlern

  • Entwicklung von EMV-Modellen zur Vorhersage und Analyse der elektromagnetischen Kompatibilität und zur Optimierung des elektromagnetischen Designs von Schaltungen und Systemen

    EMV-Messungen von leitungsgeführten und gestrahlten Emissionen von Wandlern und HF-Charakterisierung von Komponenten

  • Patent innovative Lösungen und demonstrieren Technologieführerschaft durch z.B. High-Impact-Publikationen

  • Zusammenarbeit eng mit ABB-Forschungszentren, Geschäftsbereichen und Universitäten, um die Übergangsforschung in reale Anwendungen zu überführen


• Qualifikationen für die Rolle

  • PhD in Elektrotechnik, Physik oder verwandten Disziplinen mit Spezialisierung auf Leistungselektronik oder Elektromagnetik

  • Nachgewiesene Forschungsexzellenz durch einflussreiche Veröffentlichungen und Patente

  • Tief technische Expertise in:

    • EMC/EMI Theorie und solider theoretischer Hintergrund in elektromagnetischer Modellierung und Feldsimulationen

    • Leistungselektronische Wandlertopologien, Filter, Magnete und Halbleiterschaltgeräte

    • Simulationswerkzeuge wie CST, COMSOL, ANSYS, SPICE-Schaltungssimulator (LTSpice, SIMetrix), Simulink

  • Hands-on-Laborkenntnisse in HF-elektromagnetischen Messungen (durchgeführte und/oder abgestrahlte Emissionen), mit einem proaktiven, selbstgesteuerten Ansatz zum Entwerfen, Bauen und Testen von EMV/EMI-konformen Stromrichtern. Vielseitigkeit mit der Fähigkeit, Theorie und Praxis über mehrere technische Bereiche hinweg zu verbinden.

  • Fähigkeit, in einer schnelllebigen industriellen Forschungsumgebung zu gedeihen und Ergebnisse zu liefern



  • Wir bieten unseren Mitarbeitern auch die folgenden Vorteile an:

    • Childcare


    Mehr über uns

    Im ABB-Forschungszentrum in Baden-Dättwil in der Nähe von Zürich arbeiten wir an spannenden Technologien, die die Zukunft unserer Produkte gestalten. Unsere internationalen Forschungsteams konzentrieren sich auf Power Electronics, Energy Storage, Intelligent Systems, and Switching.

    Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung.



    • style="text-align:inherit !important">

    Der Aufbau einer saubereren, intelligenteren Zukunft erfordert alle Arten von Köpfen: das Neugierige, das Mutige und das Kreative. Deshalb begrüßen wir Menschen mit allen Hintergründen und Erfahrungen.

À ABB, nous aidons les industries à fonctionner plus minces et plus propres. Vous aurez le pouvoir de diriger, de soutenir la croissance et d'être fiers de l'impact que nous créons ensemble. Rejoignez-nous et aidez à exécuter ce qui dirige le monde.

Ce poste relève de :

Gestionnaire de l'équipe de recherche - Power Electronic Systems

Votre rôle et vos responsabilités

Notre équipe a pour mission de stimuler l'innovation à l'intersection des convertisseurs électroniques de puissance et des électromagnétiques, traduisant la recherche de pointe en produits ABB de nouvelle génération. Nous nous concentrons sur la modélisation électromagnétique des systèmes et composants de convertisseurs de puissance, l'atténuation des émissions, les stratégies passives et actives de filtrage et le blindage. En vous joignant à nous, vous façonnerez l'avenir des systèmes énergétiques, générant des idées novatrices à la frontière de la recherche universitaire et de l'innovation industrielle, tout en développant des technologies de transformation qui font progresser le portefeuille de produits d'ABB.


Êtes-vous passionnée par la recherche électromagnétique dans les systèmes de convertisseur de pow-er pour un avenir durable? Nous voulons avoir de tes nouvelles ! Une équipe internationale dynamique est heureuse de vous accueillir comme notre nouveau membre. Ensemble, nous allons repousser les frontières et avoir un impact durable sur la transition énergétique.

Le modèle de travail pour le rôle est : #LI-Hybrid


Vous serez principalement responsable :

  • Pioneer concepts novateurs pour assurer la compatibilité électromagnétique et la conformité aux interférences dans les convertisseurs à haute puissance

  • Développer des modèles de CEM pour prédire et analyser la compatibilité électromagnétique et optimiser la conception électromagnétique des circuits et des systèmes

  • Mesures de CEM des émissions de convertisseurs effectuées et irradiées et caractérisation des composants

  • Solutions novatrices de brevets et démonstration d'un leadership technologique par l'entremise de publications à haut impact

  • Collaborer étroitement avec les centres de recherche ABB, les unités commerciales et les universités à la recherche sur la transition vers des applications du monde réel


• Qualifications pour le rôle

  • PhD en génie électrique, en physique ou dans une discipline connexe avec spécialisation en électronique de puissance ou en électromagnétique

  • Prouver l'excellence de la recherche démontrée par des publications et des brevets à fort impact

  • Expertise technique approfondie en :

  • Théorie de l'EMC/EMI et solide expérience théorique dans la modélisation électromagnétique et les simulations sur le terrain

  • Outils de simulation tels que le CST, le COMSOL, l'ANSYS, le simulateur de circuit SPICE (LTSpice, SIMetrix), le Simulink

  • Maîtrise en laboratoire des mesures électromagnétiques HF (émissions conduites et/ou irradiées), avec une approche proactive et autonome de la conception, de la construction et de l'essai de convertisseurs de puissance conformes à la norme EMC/EMI. Nous offrons également à nos employés les avantages suivants :





  • Nous offrons également à nos employés les avantages suivants :

  • Pratiques de travail flexibles

    • Plus sur nous

    Au Centre de recherche ABB de Baden-Dätil dans la proximité de nos produits, nous travaillons sur la forme de nos produits. Nos équipes de recherche internationales se concentrent sur l'électronique électrique, le stockage de l'énergie, les systèmes intelligents et le commutation.

    Nous nous réjouissons de recevoir votre demande.



    Construire un avenir plus propre et plus intelligent prend toutes sortes d'esprits : les curieux, les courageux et les créatifs. C'est pourquoi nous accueillons des gens de tous les horizons et de toutes les expériences.

    Appliquer aujourd'hui ou visiter https://www.abb.com pour en savoir plus sur l'impact de nos solutions à travers le monde.
